Upon reaching adulthood, youngsters will be exiled to a desolate mountain where they have to survive on their own for a determined period of time. Although this tradition is seen as cruel in modern eyes, there is a philosophy behind this practice since this will train youngsters to better adapt their survival skills to any circumstances such as Catastrophes.

entries.name: Anura
entries.content:
The Anurans (singular: Anura) are an Ancient race of Terra.

As the name suggests, Anurans have the traits of frogs and toads (Anura sp.). Though appearing entirely humanoid similar to the Aegirs, their anuran traits can be noticed such as patches of frog-like skin, preference over moist environments, and their capability to secrete toxins. Many Anurans master camouflage and invisibility Arts, and some individuals can utilize their toxins as poisons for self-defense. On the other hand, these toxins can also be easily neutralized through their immunity, and they can control the amount of their poison's toxicity.

Anurans are a rare Terran race that can only be found in the rainforests of eastern Sargon and southern Bolívar. They prefer to settle in humid regions, e.g., swamps and river valleys, and they sometimes share the same neighborhood with the Archosaurians where they often interact with each other through village help or community events like swimming contests. Sargonians have a traditional viewpoint in which Anurans are perceived as wise sages with elegant character even though this is born from misunderstanding due to their scarcity. In the modern era, the Sargonian royal court continues to practice the tradition of hiring Anurans as imperial officers in the capital of Shar-Agade. Some modern Anurans also begin to migrate outside of the rainforests to settle in nomadic cities with abundant greenery and excellent waterway management.

Iberia also has a decent population of Anurans whose ancestry could be traced back to the rainforest of Kerthun Valley, Sargon, a region that is free from the direct control of the Lords Ameer in present days. Centuries ago, a few populations of Anurans were enslaved by the Iberians to be sold as experimental subjects against the Seaborn. After the Profound Silence of 1038, the Iberian Anurans have been treated as mere outcasts. Most of the Iberian Anurans have forgotten their ancestral homeland, and they could only trace such a memory in their folktales.

entries.name: Archosauria
entries.content:
The Archosaurians (singular: Archosauria) are an Ancient race of Terra.

Archosaurians have the traits of crocodilians (Crocodilia sp.), i.e., true crocodiles, alligators, and gharials. Their crocodilian traits can be noticed such as bulky, scaly tails, scales on their bodies, muscularity, and preference over moist environments. Most of them are humanoids with a pair of pointed ears in a similar fashion with the Phidians. Some Archosaurians also demonstrate sexual dimorphism in which male Archosaurians can possess more animalistic traits when compared with females.

Archosaurians are famous for being tough warriors and hunters. Their bulky muscles grant them the physical might, and their warrior culture encourages them to become fighters. Besides, They are born excellent swimmers; they have the ability to wade in the water by swinging their bulky tails. As a matter of fact, not only an Archosaurian could fight with their muscular strength, but also they are ambushers who can perfectly hide themselves in the swamps and rivers.

Although being an uncommon race of Terra, Archosaurians are predominantly found in the eastern rainforest of Sargon, especially in the region of Acahualla where they are the natives. Acahuallan Archosaurians proudly crown themselves as "Tiacauh," an honorary title that is said to be granted from the Aslan Shahanshah who was amazed by their courage, and this title will later be adopted by non-Archosaurian Acahuallans who later integrated into their society. Acahuallan Archosaurians have the culture of adornment of their tails which could sometime lead to some seemingly unrelated topics, i.e., thickness comparison of their tails. They prefer to maximize the usage of their tails by holding tail-related contests such as log-dragging with tails. In recent years, there are even new sports influenced by foreign culture, i.e., soccer games but kicking with tails.

entries.name: Aslan
entries.content:
The Aslans are an Ancient race of Terra.

Aslans have the traits of lions (Panthera leo). Their leon traits can be noticed such as rounded ears, tails with dark tuffs of hair, mane-like hairstyle, and physical prowess. Aslans are very identical to the Felines; in fact, they are actually a Feline subgroup in biological and anthropological definitions, but they are separated independently as a royal bloodline due to politics.

The name "Aslan" comes from the Aslanian Conquest of Sargon before the common era. According to a legend, it all began from a Sargonian tribe of Felines with unique traits who would later become the Aslan house. These first Aslans in history believed they were naturally born with the "divine right of kings" to rule over other races; furthermore, they received the blessings of the leon "Lords of Beasts" that could support their campaigns. Hence, they segregated themselves from other Felines and ushered a series of conquests unto other tribes. Not only the conquest made the Aslans becoming famous, but also it ushered in the era of racial separation in which various races began naming themselves differently in accordance with their body traits or culture.

In the modern era, Aslans are the royal houses of both Sargon and Victoria. The Shahanshah of Sargon is of the Aslan dynasty. During the ninth Terran century, a royal family led by an Aslan Padishah named Lugalszamszi fled to Victoria from political persecutions of the Shahanshah. Through their charisma, they initiated a palace coup against the Draco houses of Victoria and Tara that toppled their reign. Decades later, Lugalszamszi's grandson would solidify his rule as the first Aslan King of Victoria. But since the public execution of King Alistair II in 1072, the Aslans are forever purged from the Victorian throne, forcing them to live in hiding that resulted in the twenty years of vacant throne.

entries.name: Caprinae
entries.content:
The Caprinae (both singular and plural) are an Ancient race of Terra.

Caprinae have the traits of goats (Capra sp.) and sheep (Ovis sp.). Their caprine traits can be noticed such as curved keratin horns, perky or floppy ears, and short tails pointing straight up. They possesses regular physical fitness and reflexive nimbleness.

A notable trait of the Caprinae is their superiority in Originium Arts compared to other Terran races beside the Sarkaz. As a matter of fact, many notable Arts users are mainly Caprinae. On the other hand, this has led to a stereotype by many people that they are mystic "harbingers" of said power. A theory suggests that their excellent Arts talent is born from a combination of both their physical characteristics and their nimbleness. However, some of them cannot naturally use Arts due to their innate physique or any other birth defect, though they can possess unimaginable physical strength that supplements the defect.

The Caprinae's love of their horns could lead to the point of even treating them as an aesthetic standard, which exceeds other horned races such as Fortes, Elafians, Ceratos, and even Sarkaz, with their physical differences between each other being a topic of discussion. In the Sarkaz' case, Caprinae can also be mistaken for them due to their horns and vice versa. Consequently, there have been historical cases that many spies infiltrating Sarkaz communities or Kazdel are mainly Caprinae, though they can be immediately recognized through the unrecognition of the Sarkaz's collective deceased spirits.

As one of the common races on Terra, Caprinae can be found all across the continent. Leithanien has the predominant population among all nations, and a large population of them can be found in its surroundings such as Victoria and Siracusa. As a matter of fact, it is said that Leithanien's love for arts and culture comes from the Caprinae themselves. In fact, the musical culture of the Leithanian Caprinae is believed to be the origin of the Leithanian constitution, the Güldenesgesatz that mentally binds other nine tribes under their leadership.

entries.name: Cautus
entries.content:
The Ceratoes (singular: Cerato) are an Ancient race of Terra.

Cautuses have the traits of leporids (family Leporidae), i.e., rabbits and hares. Their leporid traits can be noticed such as long rabbit ears, fluffy short tails, and average short stature. Their rabbit ears grant them a keen hearing sense which supplements their fragile body. Thanks to these traits along with their high fertility, Cautuses have a very large population.

Although Cautuses are a common race that can be found across Terra, Rim Billiton houses a predominant population of Cautuses as its natives. The Rim Billitonian Cautuses live a collective lifestyle as a community, and they work together to construct their underground hideouts nicknamed the "rabbit's hole" where they settle, cultivate drought-resistant carrots and root vegetables as staple crops, and conduct mining in Originium veins. They treat their family members as an essential core; even when one decides to travel outside to settle down on their own, their family members will continually send their support be it material or emotional. Within the community, a family with the largest members are regarded as the core leader of the community. The Cautuses' strong family relationship is the root of the Rim Billitonian family culture and their grassroot autonomous governance.

Entering the modern era, the Rim Billitonian Cautuses continue this tradition through several reforms. They organize themselves as "mining alliances," companies that assign roles to respective individuals among the families. This new organization system not only boosts the economy of Rim Billiton, but also it forms a tough political entity that could resist imperial forces as witnessed in the "Cage Incident" of 1091.

entries.name: Cerato
entries.content:
The Ceratoes (singular: Cerato) are an Ancient race of Terra.

Ceratoes have the traits of rhinoceroses (Rhinocerotidae sp.). Their rhinoceros traits can be noticed such as a single or double pointed keratin horn on the forehead, rounded, tubular ears with tufts of hair on the top edge, muscularity, and average tall stature among adults. Even though Ceratoes could run like a Kuranta, they prefer to avoid long trekking. It is believed that their heavy weight due to their muscles could quickly exhaust their stamina when running, making it a tedious job to the Ceratoes.

Ceratoes highly adore their horns. Since the tribal era, they have used their horns as their sole weapon. Face-to-face clashing is seen not only as an honor but also a way to maintain their horns by rubbing their surfaces and strengthening their endurance. Hence, a Cerato fight can be surprising to others even though they see it as a norm. In recent years, there is a popular trend that they further augment their horns by adding protective gears on them.

Ceratoes are an uncommon race on Terra, and many of them live in oasis settlements of Sargon. Sargonian Ceratoes have a tradition of aviculture by keeping and breeding fowlbeasts. A Cerato fowlbeast keeper can keep more than one fowlbeast of the same species, and elderly Ceratoes love bringing along their caged fowlbeast to their community parks. There is even a special species of fowlbeast in the Sargonian oases that builds a symbiotic relationship with the Ceratoes.

entries.name: Elafia
entries.content:
The Elafians (singular: Elafia) are an Ancient race of Terra.

Elafians have the traits of deer (Cervidae sp.). Their cervid traits can be noticed such as a pair of antlers, funnel-shaped ears, and short, rounded tails. During the early stage of their growth, their antlers are covered with skin known as velvet rather than keratin as in Caprinae and Fortes, and the velvet antlers possess nerve coverings that enable them to sense touches through their antlers. A special subgroup of them dwelling in northern Sargon and southern Columbia also possess the traits of giraffes (Giraffa sp.) such as tall stature, tail with a long, dark tuft of hair, and a pair of ossicones.

Elafians highly value their antlers as the symbol of their race. Young Elafians will interact with their velvet antlers to demonstrate their emotions, be it joy or arrogance. This is best demonstrated through a famous poem "Old Leaves and New Branch" written by two Elafian poets who debated over their topics through antler-wrestling, and the result of the poem shows the same topic with drastic approaches. To other Terrans, an Elafia's antlers is a symbol of their close interaction with nature by comparing them with tree branches. Following a Gaulish literature movement decades ago, Elafians have been stereotyped as mystic people who live a secluded lifestyle and highly venerate nature.

As a common Terran race, Elafians can be found everywhere in countries with forested regions such as Ursus, Kazimierz, and Leithanien. Of all nations, Sami houses the predominant population of Elafians; in fact, anthropologists believe that Sami is the original homeland of the Elafians before spreading across Terra. The Elafian Samfijod have a culture of treating their antlers as a sacred body part to communicate with nature. As a result, elderly Elafian Samfijod keeps their antlers growing without trimming them.

entries.name: Feline
entries.content:
The Felines are an Ancient race of Terra.
Felines have the traits of feliforms (suborder Feliformia). They usually have the traits of domestic cats (Felis catus) and big cats (Panthera sp.), though some individuals have the traits of mongooses (Herpestidae sp.). Their feline traits are visible from the shape of their ears and tail and their flexibility. Most Felines possess pointed, triangular ears and long tails, and only a few of them have rounded or folded ears and short tails. The Felines’ keen sense earns them their reputation as stealthy prowlers or flexible individuals. Some of them even possess light-sensitive pupils in which their eyes will form “slit pupils” in areas with bright light.

Along with the Perros and Liberi, Felines are the predominant Terran race who can be found in almost all Terran nations thanks to their strong adaptation to their surroundings. As a matter of fact, there goes a popular Gaulish proverb regarding the Felines: "Où que tu ailles, un Félin suit (Wherever you go, a Feline follows)." They have varieties of ethnic groups, and the most predominant Feline subgroup is perhaps the Aslans of Sargon and Victoria. Currently, Victoria houses most of the Feline population, and many of them are descendants of both the loyalists following the Aslan house back in Sargon during the ninth Terran century and the native Taran inhabitants following the two Draco houses. Hence, it has been a common case for a Victorian Feline having a distant relative back in Sargon.

Despite the varieties among the Felines, only the Aslans stand out as an independent Feline subgroup since the Aslanian Conquest. As a matter of fact, both races are separated politically despite sharing similar biology.

entries.name: Forte
entries.content:
The Fortes are an Ancient race of Terra.

Fortes have the traits of bovines (subfamily Bovinae), i.e., cattle, bison, and buffaloes. Their bovine traits can be seen, such as pointed keratin horns, rounded and protruding ears, tails with tufts of hair, and their muscularity. There are several subgroups having the traits of camelids (family Camelidae), i.e., camels and llamas, who possess camelid traits such as small, rounded ears and the ability to survive in arid deserts.

The Fortes' lack of flexibility is compensated with their excellent physical strength. Because of that, they are often stereotyped as merely physically strong yet brainless people, and this stereotype is further reinforced by the popular drink brand, Forte Energy Drink. Nevertheless, many Forte are actually known for their philosophical wisdom, especially in settlements where they are the predominant race. Legend says that ancient Fortes could be totally immersed in literary works and ideology discussions, and their lifestyle showcased a dire contrast with neighboring Reproba tribes.

Fortes are one of the common races on Terra. Among all nations, Minos has a predominant population of Fortes. Many prominent schools of philosophy were founded by Minoan Forte scholars, such as the story of Phenalates, who once dissected her philosophy with a nameless Sargonian Feline day and night. Other countries with flatland landscapes can have a decent Forte population such as Sargon and Yan, and they are often perceived as humble laborers owing to their agrarian culture. In fact, Yanese Fortes are believed to be one of the earliest ethnic groups to engage in agricultural activities. There is even a Yanese legend narrating a Forte tribe who built the earliest carriage that allowed them to travel around farmlands in mountainous regions to both observe their farm plots and quickly prepare for evacuation from Catastrophes.

entries.name: Kuranta
entries.content:
The Kuranta (both singular and plural) are an Ancient race of Terra.

Kuranta have the traits of equines (Equus sp.), i.e., horses, donkeys, and zebras. Their equine traits can be noticed such as funnel-shaped ears, tall stature, and tails being either bushy being nicknamed the "skirt" or simply having tufts of long hair at the bottom of the tail dock. Although lacking the physical strength on par with the Ursi and Fortes, Kuranta possess an enduring stamina that grants them the ability to run at high speeds with little to no fatigue.

Kuranta are a common Terran race, and among all nations, Kazimierz houses the predominant population of Kuranta. The Kazimierzian knighthood is believed to have emerged from early Kuranta nomadic confederations wandering across the grasslands. In order to defend themselves from invaders, these early knights organized themselves into a strong military defense by designating strict and rigid hierarchical orders to their family members with the family head serving as the leading knight; in modern Kazimierz, this is known as the "knight family" led by a "Knight Primus." Even in modern Kazimierz where commercialism triumphs everything, the knight-family tradition is still well-preserved through the Knights' Association.

Kuranta also includes several Elder subraces. The two notable Elder Kuranta are the Pegasi and the Nightzmoras. The former are the previous royal house of Kazimierz before being toppled by the knights in Terran year 13, and the latter originates from the Nightzmoran Khaganate under the leadership of Kharanduu Khagan. Owing to the Nightzmoran Conquests, the Kuranta were scattered across every corner of Terra which in turn formed an abundant population. In the modern era, the tales of both Pegasi and Nightzmoras remain popular among the Kuranta.

The Kuranta's excellent stamina makes them talented soldiers, especially those who undergo adequate physical training and studies of military science. According to disclosed documents provided by the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz, during the Tenth Ursus-Kazimierz War of 1062, a legion of Silverlance Pegasi managed to outpower several Ursine landships and even halted their advance through mere muscular strength. The Ursine side acknowledged the event's veracity although they do not elaborate much on the incident.

entries.name: Liberi
entries.content:
The Liberi (both singular and plural) are an Ancient race of Terra.

"Liberi" is an umbrella term referring to any Ancient and Elder race who have the traits of birds (Aves sp.), i.e., feathers growing on their hair and structures resembling tail feathers on their torsos, or feather-like features. Along with feathers, they also possess a good sense of hearing and eyesight. Generally speaking, Liberi are a medium-sized race with females being slightly shorter. Their physical fitness is relatively average at best, and they are considerably lighter in weight than other races. Some Liberi possess the traits of various bird-like mythological creatures in our world, while others resemble anthropomorphic avians.

Along with the Perros and Felines, Liberi are a predominant race on Terra having many Ancient and Elder branches. The most famous of the Elder Liberi are the Hippogryphs, the former ruling class of the Empire of Hippogryph that was later overthrown by the Ursine rebels led by Igor the Great in Terran year 31. Due to its complexity and its enormous population that gives birth to many different cultures, many Liberi anthropologists urge to further divide the Liberi into different new races, but oppositions argue that cultural differences should not be mixed with biological traits.

Because of the abundant population, Liberi can be found in almost all the Terran nations. Of all nations, Iberia has the largest population of Liberi as its predominant race, and both Laterano and Columbia have a vast majority of them. Following the independence of Columbia in 1019, a large number of Liberi immigrants across Terra was absorbed into the newborn country. According to a Liberi immigrant census published by Columbian authorities, the reason for their decision to settle in Columbia is not only for the possibility of starting a new life, but also the mysterious charisma of President Mark Max who has become a popular figure among Liberi communities. The Lateran Liberi population are descendants of homeless refugees fleeing from Catastrophes that settled at the outskirts of Laterano and later integrated into the Sankta's society after adopting their religious faith. Some of these Lateran Liberi clergies later departed Laterano to settle at the southern coastlines of Terra where they founded Iberia in hope to create a second paradise on the shores. Aside from these three countries, Gaul was once ruled by a dynasty of Liberi before its disintegration in the War of the Four Nations.

entries.name: Lupo
entries.content:
Lupos have the traits of wolves (Canis lupus). Their lupine traits can be noticed such as their pricked ears and bushy tails. They are one of the three races separated from the Perros due to cultural and biological differences along with the Vulpos and Reprobas. On the outside, they appear almost identical to a Perro, but they are also the easiest to be recognized through their unique culture, as well as having a generally coarse and hard hair in comparison.

Similar to the Perros, Lupos have a large family culture albeit being its opposite. Rather than treating their family members and friends kindly, a Lupo family treats them as disposable subordinates; antagonism between Lupo families is rather strong. They strongly value family identification such as dying of their tails, earpieces, and family symbols. Wherever one is banished from the family, they will be referred to as a "lone wolf," a derogatory term for a Lupine outcast. According to their legend and anthropological research, their strong yet crooked sense of family and their exclusivism are the consequences of the direct influence of the lupine Beast Lords, the "Signori dei Lupi," who chose their "Fangs" as their proxies in their never-ending battle royale, and the Signori's beastkins, the "wolves," had been constantly attacking ancient Lupos, forcing them to organize into strict family order. Consequently, this has given rise to their mafia culture.

Because of their strict family order, a Lupo has learned to suppress their ancestral behaviors from the Perros. Rather than using their tails and ears to indicate their emotions, a Lupo soldato in a mafia learns to use hand signals to express themselves, and they learn to control their ears and tails . Even though non-famiglia Lupos do not resist the use of their tails and ears, many Lupo prefer not to do so, believing that it will further exhaust themselves.

Lupos can be found in many Terra nations. Siracusa holds the predominant population of Lupo as their homeland, and eastern Leithanien has the second largest population due to shared history with Siracusa before its independence in Terran year 979. Victoria and Ursus also hold a certain number of Lupos.

entries.name: Manticore (race)
entries.content:
The Manticore is an Ancient race of Terra.
As the name suggests, Manticores have the traits of the namesake chimeric creature in Persian mythology. They can be seen on their bat wing-like appendixes on both sides of the head, and a scorpion tail on their torso, usually ending with a strong and sometimes poisonous stinger. They are generally roughly the height of an average Terran, though female Manticores are usually shorter than males, yet both genders demonstrate excellent physical flexibility. They are also prominent in the use of invisibility Originium Arts which allow them to camouflage and conceal themselves during ambush.

As a rare Terran race, all Manticores live in remote regions of Sargon far away from nomadic cities. Most Manticores live in seclusion from the outside world, and due to their cultural practices, they prefer to keep a low profile, rarely appearing in the public eye while keeping a distance from other races. Even at the advent of the Crystallization Era, Manticores simply preferred to not enter nomadic cities and retain their simple albeit isolated lives.

Because of their secularism and mysterious background, there is a pejorative perception regarding this race. Many perceive them as "man-eaters" or "harbingers" of curse, resulting in many Manticores refusing to accept others as guests visiting their settlements.

entries.name: Perro
entries.content:
The Perros are an Ancient race of Terra.

Perros have the traits of dogs (Canis familiaris). Their canid traits can be easily noticed such as pricked, folded, or floppy ears, pointed or curled tails, and their keen sense of smell. In addition, their hair/fur is significantly more finer and softer compared to a Lupo. Perros are known for demonstrating their emotions outwardly through their body parts such as wagging tail and folding ears. A notable culture practiced among the Perros are their large family and their loyalty to their families and friends. In a traditional Perro community, the families that make up the community are regarded as part of a larger family. Because of their family culture, Perros highly values peace and harmony between family and friends. Even when one faces difficulties, a Perro will always stay on their side.

Before the dawn of human civilization, Perros was an umbrella term referring to their shared canine traits. After the Aslanian Conquest that ushered in the era of racial separation, many Perros were further divided into three specific groups based on different cultures and traits: Lupos, Vulpos, and Reprobas. Consequently, many people find it hard to differentiate between the actual Perros and these separated Perro subgroups. Perros also includes various Elder subraces such as the Cerberus, Uridimmu, and Qursha, though many of them have already integrated into the Perro population.

Along with the Felines and Liberi, Perros are the predominant Terran race who can be found in almost all Terran nations thanks to their large population. From the wilderness of Sargon and Sami to the cities of Higashi, Ursus, and Victoria, Perros can be found everywhere. Of all nations, Bolívar houses most of the Perro population, but in recent years, there have been major protests among the Bolívarian Perros in regards to the usage of "hounds" which many presume are bioengineered creatures born from Perros undergoing cruel experiments despite the lack of evidences.

There is an interesting yet peculiar history between the Perros and hotdogs. Urban legends say that the first hotdog was created by Bolívarian Perros whose immigrants introduced this sausage sandwich to the Columbians. In Kazimierz, in order to attract customers to their food carts during the Kazimierz Major, Columbian hawkers would hire seductive Perro females or muscular male Perro body-builders to promote the dish, leaving an everlasting impression to the Terran populace.

entries.name: Petram
entries.content:
The Petrams are an Ancient race of Terra.
Petrams have the traits of turtles (Testudines sp.), i.e., tortoises, terrapins, and sea turtles. Unlike other races, they are totally humanoid and are completely devoid of any testudinate trait such as short tails, scales, and even shells. One peculiar explanation describes that this unique phenomenon is ironically the result of Originium: Petrams have some of the highest amounts of Originium assimilation. As Originium molded their ancestors in the image of man, these earliest Petrams willingly accepted it to become true humans. On the other hand, the large amount of Originium shards inside a Petram's body makes them highly vulnerable to Oripathy and its side effects.

Petrams are a very rare race on Terra that only settle in aquatic environments, i.e., swamps, rivers, and coastlines. These populations are only found in nations with coastlines such as Iberia, Yan, and Victoria. Because of their reclusive nature and scarcity of their populations, little to no available information about Petrams is available for contemporary academic circles. Even a few researchers debate that Petrams never existed and could only be found in legends.

A unique culture of the Petrams is their mastery in metallurgy. Petram metals differ from others because they are made of highly advanced techniques that are unknown to outsiders, hence they possess excellent endurance and hardness. An archeological site in Sargon has once excavated an ancient execution site with Petram tools that are dated back millennia ago, but the metal that made up the tools highly resembled modern-day alloys. Despite lacking knowledge of modern science, many Petrams are trained to become outstanding craftsmen and materials scientists. Because of the mysteries surrounding their metallurgy, there are many legends regarding the Petrams and their metals that are often filled with exaggerations. A Sargonian folktale narrates Petrams "slaying their ancestors in the numbers of thousands" and "burying them in ruins sunken beneath the lakes." There was a historical record that a Lord Ameer sought to acquire their techniques but was met with disappointment because of the Petrams' refusal.

A particular phenomenon observed from some Petrams is their close contact with Aegirs living ashore. They often refer to each other as "fellow race" despite their physical differences. This phenomenon is not present in other races, or at the very least it has not been recorded beforehand. To this day, no scientific explanation has given out a satisfactory conclusion regarding this extremely close tie.

entries.name: Phidia
entries.content:
The Phidians (singular: Phidia) are an Ancient race of Terra.

Phidians have the traits of snakes (suborder Serpentes). Their serpentine traits can be noticed such as scaly tails, scales on parts of their bodies, and their extremely keen senses. Phidians possess a pair of pointed ears. Their average weight and muscularity are surprisingly below standard, yet their average height is taller than others, making their bodies appear slim and feeble.

Phidians are quite uncommon among the known Terran races. Nevertheless, their presence can be found almost everywhere from the tundra of Sami and the boreal forests of Ursus to the deserts of Sargon and cities of Victoria. Phidians are an individualist race; they prefer living alone instead of forming a close-knit community.

Because of their rather dispersed and scarce population, Phidians are subjected to various misunderstandings, stereotypes, and even discrimination. Their feeble bodies cause others to have the wrong perceptions that Phidians are "as weak as a baby," though muscular Phidians do exist. Their keen senses have been often described as emotionally unstable, or simply a maniac. Many Terrans have a derogatory view regarding the Phidians by associating them with negative manners such as slyness, lies, and bully; many pejorative terms in various Terran languages have associations with "snakes," a slur to the Phidians, such as "snake in the grass" in Victorian or di tou se in Yanese meaning "scoundrel." Making hissing sounds or wriggling like a snake in front of a Phidia are regarded as racist gestures. Most importantly, contrary to the popular belief, Phidians do not secrete venoms. Ironically, many Phidians are excellent chemists or toxicologists who can manufacture their own poison through artificial chemicals for self-defense.

A positive notation of a Phidian's character is perhaps the tendency to focus on a specific goal. They can dedicate themselves to a particular goal and will never be diverted from it despite the obstacles and disturbances. There was a Phidan who have been studying in engineering of colorful signal lights as a communication methods, and he was hired to construct a signal system for the Kjeragian Staatbahn; and there was another famous female Phidian whose passion over the Kazimierz Major drove her to publish annual theses over the Major's champions.

entries.name: Pilosa
entries.content:
The Pilosa (both singular and plural) are an Ancient race of Terra.

Pilosa have the traits of sloths (suborder Folivora). Similar to the Petrams, Pilosa are entirely humanoid and are devoid of folivoran traits such as hairy fur and long claws. The only visible folivoran trait is their distinctive slow speech and actions, making them literally "as slow as a sloth." On the other hand, this disadvantage is compensated by their taciturn and cautious nature during work time.

Pilosa are a very rare race whose existence has been barely documented by others. Due to their behaviors, they are rather scattered across Terra. Their rather quiet nature causes others to see them as unfriendly "strangers." On top of that, they rarely appear publicly, and they can be easily mistaken as other races. Because of the scarcity of their information, many presume that Pilosa are just some urban legends. Nevertheless, there are some first-hand accounts describing their behaviors, and some popular media loves depicting them as peculiar caricatures.

entries.name: Reproba
entries.content:
The Reprobas are an Ancient race of Terra.
Reprobas have the traits of hyenas (family Hyaenidae). Their hyenid traits can be noticed such as pricked ears and tails with tufts of hair, spots, or stripes. They have a moderate physical fitness when compared with other races, although female Reprobas are generally stronger than males. Reprobas are one of the three races separated from the Perros due to cultural and biological differences along with the Lupos and Vulpos which often results in mistakes of recognition by other races, but their population is the least of them all as they are the last Perro subgroup to be diverged since the Aslanian Conquest. Reprobas also includes various Elder subraces, though many of them have already integrated into the Reproba population.

Reprobas practices several ancient cultures that are seen as peculiar to other races. Although Reprobas inherits the Perros' large family culture similar to the Lupos', there are some differences. Unlike Perros, Reprobas value internal unity and discipline the most. A traditional Reprobah family is a matriarchy in which the most powerful matriarch leads the family who is nominally elected by many different tribes as their "guardian." Despite spending most of their lives in the arid wilderness, a Reproba family can grow up to more than a hundred family members. Reprobas also have a tradition of close interactions with the Sarkaz since the tribal era, but such practice is a very controversial one among other Perro subgroups due to their enmity against the Sarkaz. Consequently, there are discriminatory perceptions on the Reprobas in which they are often described as having similarities with the Sarkaz, resulting in various ghost stories having them as main characters, though many Reprobas do not bother over the discrimination.

As a very rare race, most of the Reproba population can be found in the desert regions of western Sargon. They have been living as desert wanders which nourishes their rich culture. Throughout history, Reproba warriors are highly valued by the Shahanshah owing to their long-standing military tradition. Legend even says that female Reproba elite warriors had formed a tough frontline during the invasion of Sargon by the Nightzmoran hordes. Entering the modern era, many Reprobas have left Sargon and spread across Terra as immigrants. By utilizing their knowledge in wilderness survival, many of them have been dedicating themselves in biological research, geology, and animal husbandry.

entries.name: Savra
entries.content:
The Savrans (singular: Savra) are an Ancient race of Terra.

Savrans have the traits of lizards that includes true lizards (superorder Lepidosauria), i.e., geckos, chameleons, monitor lizards, and tuatara, and lizard-like animals, i.e., the amphibian salamanders (Urodela sp.). Their lacertilian and salamandrine traits can be noticed such as scales covering the bodies, scaly tails, and agileness. Many Savrans also have the natural ability of camouflage by changing their skin color. As a matter of fact, many Savrans are talented hunters and ambushers who could perfectly blend with their surroundings after wearing camouflage clothing. Some of them even master specific Arts to further augment their camouflage by altering the colors of objects they touch.

Some of the Savrans' unusual characteristics are their elongated lifespan, generally 120–140 years, and their ectothermic bodies. While it is true that many Sarvans can live up to centuries, it has become a subject of stereotype due to exaggerations. Various pop culture and fictional works describe elderly Savrans as mystic old men who are prone to wickedness.[1] Furthermore, the current record holder of longevity is Ibn Erhad, a Sargonian Savra Padishah who's said to have lived for 230 years thanks to his rather curious lifestyle, claiming that he only slept for half a day.[3] The Savrans’ ectothermic bodies means that they have to frequently undergo sunbathing. As a matter of fact, they love spending their time in sunny, open-space places, e.g. deserts and shrublands, and most of the Savrans settle in these arid regions.

Savrans are an uncommon race on Terra, and most of the populations live in the desert regions of Sargon and Rim Billiton. Due to the stereotype regarding their lifespan, some Sargonian folktales have a fixed image of an elderly Savran hunter with a smoky voice, a crooked smile, and a cunning yet cruel sense of humor. Nevertheless, in other stories, they are also seen as the embodiment of wisdom. This stems from a common practice among Sargonian Savrans in which they could meditate and dissect their philosophy for long periods of time while enjoying their sunbathing.

entries.name: Ursus (race)
entries.content:
The Ursi (singular: Ursus) are an Ancient race of Terra.

Ursi have the traits of bears (family Ursidae), i.e., brown bears, black bears, polar bears, and giant pandas. Their ursine traits can be seen from their rounded ears, short and unnoticeable tails, and a bulky stature than other Terrans. As one of the most common Terran races, the vast majority of Ursi live in the Ursus Empire, with decent populations found in temperate countries of the north such as Yan, Kazimierz, Kjerag, and Sami; there is even a population of them living in the deserts of northern Sargon.

The Ursi's most distinguishable feats are their tall height and outstanding physical strength compared to other races, which are attributes they generally like to emphasize. They also possess a highly-developed endurance as a result of the harsh environment they live in, i.e., frigid winters in the northern regions. The Ursi have a large number of subraces, each with different hair and fur color, though the most common ones are black, brown, and white.

The term "Ursus" can be traced back to the prehistoric era when the earliest humans began referring to other races by names. They once followed the Hippogryphs' northern migration while fleeing from the Teekaz, and were later subjugated as low-class citizens by their Elder overlords. After their incompetence during the invasion of the Nightzmoran Khagan, the Hippogryphs were overthrown by the Ursi in the Terran year 31, under the lead of Igor the Great. The establishment of the Ursus Empire ended the reign of the Elder dynasties and gave birth to the era of ethno-nationalism.

The difference between the terms "Ursus race" and "Ursus Empire" is the context; While the former is used to directly and objectively identify the race, the latter is a national identity where individuals refer to themselves as Ursine citizens regardless of their race, even outside the country.

entries.name: Vouivre
entries.content:
The Vouivres are an Ancient race of Terra.

Vouivres have the traits of "lesser dragons," i.e. dragon-like creatures in various mythologies such as wyverns, wyrms, hydras, drakes, and amphipteres. They are almost identical to the Dracos such as unique-shaped horns, large dragon-like tails, and supreme physical prowess, and this causes others to mistake both races frequently given the scarcity of the Draco population. Their only difference from the Dracos are Originium Arts talents; Vouivres lack the innate talent to enhance superior Arts, especially pyro Arts. Vouivres are able to regulate their own metabolism to reduce food consumption that is most likely as a survival mechanism against the harsh deserts where they originate from.

Although not a common Terran race, Vouivres can be found in mainly Sargon and Victoria. They originated from the deserts in northern Sargon that were subjugated by the Aslans during the Aslanian Conquest at the dawn of human civilization. Even though the Vovuires were immediately defeated, the Aslan house was impressed by their physical strength. As a tribute of their admiration, Sargon granted them more territories in the north as well as political autonomy of their region, the present-day "Vouivre Alliance," in exchange for their service to the Aslans as their royal guards. Since the demise of Lugalszargus in the year 15 that fractured the Sargonian palace, the Vouivres sought to gain independence from Sargon that lasted until the present days, though this came with heavy consequences as the Ameers dispatched troops to suppress the rebellion. In the ninth century, an Aslan royal offshoot fled Sargon to Victoria from the Shah's political persecutions while carrying several Vouivre royal guards. These Vouivres who followed the Aslan King later became the ancestors of the modern Vouivre population in Victoria.

Owing to their long-standing military tradition as royal guards for the Aslan Shahanshah, Vouivres are famous as excellent soldiers. Traditional Vouivre families will have their children receive stern military training as cultivation for new guards. Those qualified Vouivres will be dispatched to the Sargonian palace to serve as royal guards. Others who are disqualified will simply search for alternative routes to continue their military career; as such, they become proficient soldiers and mercenaries. In recent years, many Vouivres who have ended their military career have chosen to settle in other countries such as Columbia.

entries.name: Vulpo
entries.content:
The Vulpos are an Ancient race of Terra.

Vulpos have the traits of foxes such as the true foxes (Vulpes sp.) and other fox-like canids (i.e., Lycalopex sp.). Their vulpine traits can been noticed such as large, protruding ears and long, bushy tails unlike Lupos and Perros. They are one of the three races separated from the Perros due to cultural and biological differences along with the Lupos and Reprobas. Vulpos also includes various Elder subraces such as Kitsune, Coyotl and Fyrla, though many of them have already integrated into the Vulpo population.

On the outside, Vulpos are sometimes mistaken for Perros due to their almost identical physical appearances; hence, many Vulpos are already getting used to the mishaps. Nevertheless, they can be recognized through their medium-sized stature and their keen flexibility amongst other Terrans. In fact, in the ancient era before their divergence from the Perros, Vulpos were often described as the ”most agile of Perros.” Because of their traits, many Vulpos are depicted as outstanding combatants in various cultures like the protagonist of the Minoan epic To Próto Vélos. Many Vulpos often work as scouts, mercenaries, or Catastrophe Messengers since the dawn of human civilization.

Despite their small number when compared with other races, Vulpos can be found anywhere on Terra with a considerable population living in Siracusa. Because their fluffy tails have been seen as their racial icon and a symbol of family unification, Siracusan Vulpos, especially those in the Siracuan mafia, have a unique culture of holding tail-grooming contests in which contestants have to groom a Vulpo’s tail based on the organizers' proposal within seventy-two seconds or less. Being heavily influenced by the Lupos' mafia culture, some Siracusan Vulpos also organize themselves into famiglie and crime families, and many point out that such a degenerate culture has "corrupted the Vulpo's traditional kindness" and turn them into "foxes that are fiercer than the wolves."

entries.name: Zalak
entries.content:
The Zalaks are an Ancient race of Terra.

Zalaks have the traits of rodents (family Rodentia), i.e., mice, squirrels, hamsters, prairie dogs, and beavers, although a few individuals have traits of rodent-like animals such as rat-like marsupials, i.e., opossums (order Didelphimorphia) and Australasian possums (suborder Phalangeriformes), and small-sized insectivores, i.e., shrews (family Soricidae) and moles (family Talpidae). Their rodent, possum, and insectivorous traits can be noticed such as pointed or rounded ears with hair tufts, slim or bushy tails, keen senses, average short stature, and high fertility. Zalaks demonstrates different variations depending on geography. For instance, those from the Kjeragian mountain range spanning from Kazimierz to Kjerag have thick, fluffier tails and bushy ear tufts, whereas those from warmer regions in the south have thinner hair on their ears and tails.

Despite their short stature compared to other races, Zalaks' agility compensates for the disadvantage. Their large ears and sharp eyes enable them to possess exceptional hearing and reflexes, and through them, they are very sensitive to ambient vibrations and airflow changes. These qualities allow Zalaks to survive in harsh, barren environments. As a matter of fact, many Zalaks often work as communication Messengers or Catastrophe Messengers.

Thanks to their high fertility that enables them to give birth to large numbers of babies, a feat shared with the Cautuses' large family, Zalaks are a common race who can be found anywhere on Terra from Bolívar to Rim Billiton through their abundant population. In recent years, there is an increase of Zalaks immigrating to Columbia. One of the possible reasons is that they are motivated by prominent Zalak movie stars in the Columbian Wrankwood film industry such as Berne Gayley, Anthony Irving, and Kazimierzian actress Magda "Quickmouth" Molinsky who spotlighted the Zalak populace in a positive manner through their block-busting movies, i.e., the 1094 comedy Come On! Not Again starring Gayley as the protagonist Jack Scoutnut. As a matter of fact, the word "Zalak Syndrome," originally a derogatory term that stereotyped Zalaks as greedy, compulsive collectors, has gradually become a commendatory idiom that describes a person's planning ahead for themself and their families. The public promotion of the "Zalak Syndrome" also attracts many Zalaks to join the Columbian frontier pioneers who make their contribution through their accumulated wealth and enduring adaptations to the harsh environment.

Some Zalaks possess an innate phobia towards Felines. Despite having no particular animosity towards them, they will try their best to keep a distance from Felines, especially those who have taller stature. If spending too much time with them, they will demonstrate physical discomforts such as rigid muscles, muttering, and eyes turning red.

entries.name: ---Elders---
entries.content:
The Elders are an umbrella term for a small group of Terran races who were formerly the royalties and bourgeoisie class of Terran nations, but today are equal to, if not in a higher status than the Ancients. Unlike Ancients, many Elders possess traits of mythological animals in our world's mythologies. Most Elders are racially distinct from the Ancients, but some are the subrace of (or more appropriately, related to) certain Ancient races.

The Elders possess superior abilities lost to time such as elongated lifespan that could surpass many Ancients and unimaginable Arts that are exaggerated in many legends (e.g. weather control and spiritual communication). In Sarkaz religious narratives, these early Elder leasers "descended" upon Terra, titled the "Hegemons," manifested even more exaggerated powers that were described as one that could "shun the sunray." But since the Amnannam and the collapse of the first Kazdel era, the supernatural power of the Elders have gradually lost due to the influence of Originium, making them completely weaker than their ancestors. Nevertheless, many Elders continue to see themselves as "pure-blooded" through their surviving traits, hence distinguishing themselves from the rest politically.

Since their "descend" upon Terra, the Elders had been holding on the philosophy of the "divine right of kings" due to their unique traits. They had literally enslaving the majority Ancients by using them as their slaves and pawns against the Sarkaz. Entering the feudal era, they implemented rigid, racist, and unfair inegalitarian policies that worsened their oppression. However, their dominance came to an end by the hands of another Elder race, the Nightzmoras, during their worldwide conquests. From Terran year 31 onwards when the Ursi toppled the Hippogryphs, many Elders forever lost such "divine rights," and those surviving Elders have either chosen to integrate into the Ancients' society or used meritocratic capabilities to climb back to the top of the social hierarchy once again.

entries.name: Draco
entries.content:
Dracos have the traits of European dragons in Western mythology. Their draconic traits can be noticed such as dragon horns, hard scales, bulky and majestic serpentine tails, and highly advanced physical strength. Because of their identical similarities, Dracos can be easily mistaken as Vouivres.

Nevertheless, Dracos can be easily distinct from Vouivres with one special trait: their capability to manipulate fire through Originium Arts. While pyro Arts is not unique to the Dracos, their power has a unique quirk that distinguishes it from ordinary fire fundamentally. The fire they produce is not based on natural combustion effect but the manipulation of the living cell metabolism. Their cell tissues will literally burn itself due to a sudden increase of metabolism that makes them hyperactive, and the manifestation of fire is a mere side effect of their inner combustion. As a matter of fact, their unique fiery traits earn them the title of "Red Dragons." Some could even take it further by manipulating metabolism of others' cells such as necromantic Arts that can temporarily "revive" a corpse by injecting their fire within.

Dracos are an extremely rare Elder race who are found in numerous scattered communities across Terra with different physical characteristics depending on the region. They are famous for being a prominent royal house who actively involve themselves in the geopolitics of Terra. Oddly enough, the name "Draco" would not come to use as a collective name until the most recent millennium when their houses became more close-knit and needed an identification to refer to themselves. On the other hand, the sharing of a common racial name often overlooks their diverse cultures and physical differences among houses, leading many scholars to doubt whether it is appropriate to refer to them as such.

Throughout history, Dracos are prominent figures in various legends and folktales appearing as either trustworthy heroes or greedy tyrants. These legends include the horror story of a Draco king who dehorned the horns of other enslaved races and grounded them to nourish their own, the tale of an immortal, ruthless Draco overlord who caused havoc continuously throughout millennia. Another interesting Victorian legend involves a greedy Draco King who hoarded all the plundered gold and Originium artifacts in a treasure vault which is still a hot topic among treasure hunters. Nevertheless, many of these stories are purely fictional as bedtime stories to children.

The Dracos were previously the dominant rulers of the heartland regions that would later become the nation-states of Victoria and Tara. The introduction of the Sargonian monarchical system caused a split of the Draco house: the conservative who sought to preserve their semi-nomadic lifestyle and the monarchists who preferred to crown themselves as kings. Both houses became the Gaelic Kings of Tara and the Draco Kings of Victoria respectively, but they were forcefully merged back to Victoria at the dawn of the common era during the pillage of the Nightzmoran hordes with an unglorified past. In 737, the Aslan house plundered the Dracos of both Victoria and Tara, forcing them to share their throne with the latter. Their lineage was further severed after several secret conspiracies — supposedly plotted by the Unicorns supporting the Aslans from the shadows — in the most recent two decades to fully eliminate their potential rivals which led to their total disappearance in the political circle.

By modern days, the Dracos are quickly forgotten among the Terrans, presuming them to be fully extinct. Nevertheless, there are still some surviving lineages that seek to reclaim their former glory. These surviving houses include the Artorius who fled to Lungmen, Yan, as fugitives and the Dublinns who claim themselves as the direct descendants of the Taran King Gaeil.

entries.name: Hippogryph
entries.content:
The Hippogryph is an Elder subrace of the Liberi. 

Hippogryphs have the traits of the eponymous legendary creature found in Orlando Furioso. They are essentially Liberi with partial Kuranta traits such as equine tails and ears.

The Hippogryphs are a famous Elder race who were once the ruling dynasty of the Empire of Hippogryph. At the dawn of human civilizations, the Hippogryphs migrated to the northern mountains to flee from harassment of the Teekaz, and they enslaved several Ancient races to construct their mountain castles and fortresses. The Hippogryphs’ despotism, however, came to an abrupt end in Terran year 31 when the Ursine rebels led by Igor the Great toppled them in response to their failure in defense from the Nightzmoran Conquests. After the end of their dynasty, they once endured severe persecutions under the "Eastern March" policy imposed by Aleksey Igorevich the “Young” as the remnants sought shelter in the mountainous region of eastern Ursus. Despite losing their former glory, many Hippogryphs have since been slowly reincorporated back in the Ursine government as low-ranked officials and military leaders, while others choose to live among the Ancient populace as commoners.

entries.name: Kylin
entries.content:
The Kylin (both singular and plural) is an Elder race of Terra.

Kylin have the traits of the qilin, a chimeric legendary creature in Chinese mythology. Their qilin trait can be noticed such as draconic horns resembling cervid antlers and equine tails. Because of their similar appearance, they are often mistaken as Elafians. The only difference is their culture: Elafians live a more mystic, secluded lifestyle owing to their shamanistic belief, while the Kylin have a more worldly way of living.

Kylin are a rare Elder race that can only be found in Yan and its surrounding. Since the tribal era before the Hundred Clans Rebellion, they had been part of the Yanese dynasty by serving as royal guards or sorcerers, or zhu in Yanese, to the Tribe of Yan. There are many legends of Kylin casters wielding excellent Originium Arts such as the legend of Zhu the Kylin who summoned lightning upon a lake surface to repel dangerous wild beasts; hence, they have been often associated with lightning Arts. Entering the imperial dynastic era, they were promoted to become top-ranking mandarins and law enforcers serving the True Lung, the Emperor of Yan. Because of their prominent roles, the Kylin race has become a symbol of social stability and an embodiment of imperial law.

There are various houses of Kylin in the Yanese imperial courts. The most prominent one is the Zhu clan, the legendary founder of the Lei Fa who are some of the first Tianshi of Yan spreading the knowledge of Arts to the populace. The Lin clan and the Fa clan are also notable Kylin houses who mainly run the Yanese judiciary system as judges and censors.

entries.name: Lung
entries.content:
The Lung (both singular and plural) is an Elder race of Terra.

Lung have the traits of Chinese dragons, the Long, in East Asian mythology. Their Long traits can be noticed such as antler-like horns and serpentine tails with hair tufts. Some individuals can possess more animalistic traits such as carp-like whiskers, lion mane-like hair, deer-like ears, and fish fins and scales.

The Lung are a unique ethnic group that is only found in Yan and its surroundings such as Higashi, and many of them are either imperial members of the Yanese dynasty or upper-class bourgeoisie, i.e., tycoons, aristocrats, civil servants. The history of Yan is specifically intertwined with the dynasty of Lung house since the tribal era of Yan the Chieftain who united the Hundred Clans of Yan, and anthropologists even believe that the Lung are some of the surviving oldest races on Terra whose civilizations are the first to emerge in eastern Terra if their historical accounts are accurate. The dynasty of Yan, including the ruling Yanese Emperor, often refer to themselves as the "True Lung", an honorific title that refers to their respectful veneration over their ancestors and Yan the Chieftain; the "True (Zhen)" in this case is hence not the antonym of "false" but rather an honor as the true and genuine successors of ancestral respect.

The Lung house is known to be ardent history lovers. In order to showcase their narratives to later generations, they often have official historian archivists whose job is to research and write down historical records which are later stored in their imperial libraries overseen by the Yanese Ministry of Rites. These histories covers from the unification of the the Yan tribe, the Hundred Clan Rebellion, the Great Hunt against the Feranmuts, to later history into the modern era, and many famous Yanese official histories include Tales of the Lung, Origin of the Hundred Names, and Common History of the Hundred Clans. Because they are certified by the imperial court with concrete facts and humanistic approach, the Lung's history can be seen as a legitimate primary source when compared with other nations' narratives that are based on oral traditions or religious foundation.[1]

Since the end of Yanese isolation in 845 and diplomatic establishment with nations of the Terran heartland, there have been frequent interactions between the Lung house of Yan and the Draco house of Victoria. There was even a period of history in which the Dracos also adopted the name of "Lung" as a Yanese translation and referred to the Lung house as a "Draco dynasty" in Victorian translation. This was based on inaccurate presumptions among foreign envoys when attempting to translate their respective names. Consequently, many Yanese were at one time shocked that the Dracos were actually their long-lost cousins. Over the course of active communication, both houses eventually corrected their names in their translations. After the Aslans' palace coup that toppled the Victorian Dracos, some of them have been seeking refuge in Yan and even quietly integrated into the Yanese dynasty.

entries.name: Nightzmora
entries.content:
The Nightzmora is an Elder subrace of the Kuranta. 

Nightzmoras have the traits of mares, specifically the modern interpretation from The Nightmare and Nightmares in Dungeons and Dragons in which they are depicted as black or red horses associated with illusions and nightmares. True to the fact, pure-blooded Nightzmoras usually possess red hair and tail, and they are proficient in psychic and illusory Arts.

The Nightzmoras are a famous Elder race of the Kuranta who originate from the Nightzmoran Khaganate. Between Terran year 11 and 15, the Nigtzmoras were led by Kharanduu Khagan and initiated the "Nightzmoran Conquests," a worldwide conquest across the continent. Starting from the eastern steppes of Ursus, the Nightzmoran hordes not only violently raided many countries, but also brought the collapse of many Elder regimes such as the Hippogryphs and Pegasi. The campaign abruptly ended in Sargon when the Khagan made a military alliance with Lugalszargus to initiate the grand conquest of the Foehn Hotlands against the southern Collapsals in year 14 where both monarchs never returned from the battle.

Owing to their nomadic lifestyle, Nightzmoras have a tradition called the "Khaganquest," a coming-of-age ritual in which a young Nightzmora needs must leave their homeland with only their weapons in their hands after making a solemn oath to their parents to bring back their glory, and they must choose their preferred site of trial to train their warriorship. These youngsters need to return to their parents in glory, either through wealth or trophies of slain enemies.

After the disappearance of the Khagan, many Nightzmoras were forced to be scattered across Terra with the collapse of their Khaganate. In the modern era, they are considered to be a very rare race with only a handful of populations settling in Sargon. Many present-day Nightzmoras have since turned to criminal activities, i.e., kidnap, illegal scalping, and robbery, to continue their nomadic lifestyle, and most of them have long forgotten their ancestry and their ancestral homeland although they still practice their "Khaganquest" without knowing its symbolism.

entries.name: Pegasus
entries.content:
The Pegasus (plural Pegasi) is an Elder subrace of the Kuranta.

Pegasi have the traits of the eponymous winged horse in Greek mythology. Contrary to the imagination, they do not possess avian features, instead having naturally golden or white hair. Legend says that they have "golden blood" likely manifested from their proficiency in luminal Arts.

The Pegasi are a famous Elder race of the Kuranta who were the former ruling dynasty of Kazimierz. Through their charisma and leadership, the Pegasian dynasty was solidified after seeking support from the Kuranta knight orders and managed to occupy the fertile grasslands of Kazimierz at the dawn of human civilization. However, during the 12th Terran year, the hordes of the Nightzmoras reached Kazimierz, and the Pegasi suffered a humiliating defeat that forced them into a peace negotiation. The knight orders who refused the negotiation openly denounced their legitimacy, and a year later, the Pegasi were ultimately toppled by the Kazimierzian knight orders.

In the modern era, the Pegasi remain prominent in Kazimierz’s politics despite losing their royalty. The Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz and the Silverlance Pegasi are all led by Pegasi who upholds the traditionalist viewpoint of chivalry that remains uncorrupted by the country’s rampant capitalism. Several knight families like House Nearl are either fully made up of pure-blooded Pegasi or Kuranta having Pegasian lineage.

entries.name: -----Other Races-----
entries.content: Other races of Terra.

entries.name: Beast Lord
entries.content:
The "Lords/Sovereigns of Beasts" or simply Beast Lords/Beast Aristocrats are a "race" of Terra.

The "Lords of the Beasts" are literal talking animals, animals that are identical with our world's, with supernatural power such as immortality, teleportation, and immense knowledge that can be traced back to the "Predecessors" of Terra. They claim to have never been "born", rather claiming to be "manifestations" since time immemorial. In fact, they are actually sentinel animal spirits roaming across Terra while remaining invisible to most of the Terrans. These attributes make them similar to various land and animal spirits in our world's mythologies like European familiars, Ainu kamuy, Native American manitou, and East African shetani.

The Beast Lords are often confused with other anthropomorphic Ancients like Wei, the Rat King, and Gopnik, or even the Feranmuts, the "deities" of Terra. However, they are not related to both of them. Similar with the Elves and the Feranmuts, the Beast Lords have no reliance to Originium unlike the rest of Terra. Rather, they are even considered to be the "opposite" of Originium's traits.

Due to their animal traits, the Lords have a primitive "impulse" similar to animal instincts that influence the way they live. However, such instinctive impulses can be overcome, thus allowing them to comprehend intelligence and human knowledge, as well as formulate their own meanings of life.

Each Ancient Terran race has a Lord representing them. For example, Amma, as the "Lord of the Deer," represents the Elafian race. There can be multiple Lords representing the race, like the Signore dei Lupi representing the Lupo race.


Origin
According to the oracles of the "Sovereigns," they encountered the first Catastrophe on Terra that destroyed their physical bodies, but in the process, they suddenly become immortal, indestructible spirits.

As stated above, the Beast Lords are sentinel animal spirits. Furthermore, they have a rather peculiar origin — they are spirits formed from a forced separation of their minds from their original bodies.[3] According to legends, the origin of these Sovereigns began when many of the animals were killed by the disaster caused by the first Originium disposed upon the planet. Those who are unfortunately killed in the disaster were affected by the power of Originium which turn their consciousness into spirits. Following their transcension, their spirits scattered across the continent while leaving behind their physical traces and witnessing the millennial evolution of Terra's civilization.

By the time these animal spirits encountered the modern Terrans, they were eager to make interaction with them, but their psychic appearances made them intangible to the humans. In order to make them visible, they deployed various means to showcase their existences. Some of these spirits even collected themselves into one single entity. And because of their omnipotent manifestation and their undeniable contribution to the foundation of modern Terra, they saw themselves as the genuine "inhabitants" before the birth of the first humans, hence their epithet as the "Sovereigns" of all humans.


Relationship with humans
Despite having their power outside of the realm of Originium, the Lords of the Beasts could actually manipulate the Originium granules inside the Terrans' bodies. Thus, they are able to stay side by side with the Terrans. Through the Terrans' Originium granules, they can create an illusion upon them, hence making them consider the Beast Lords as ordinary Terrans or ordinary animals. In fact, when a human is not manipulated by the "Sovereigns," all they see is actually other objects like trees, stones, or walls. Their tricky manifestation make them hard to be studied academically, and many Terrans only regard them as mere legends. Only some individuals choose to fuly reveal themselves to only certain people as in the case of Dolly's Little Black Sheep.
Most Beast Lords choose to coexist with the Terrans while others approach a more aggressive method like the Signore dei Lupi.


Beastkins
Beastkins, sometimes erroneously called Spirit Animals by the Terrans, are fragments of the Beast Lords used to communicate with the Terrans. Their nature is similar to the dæmons in His Dark Materials, and most of them are corporeal and harmless. It is through beastkins that the Terrans treats the Beast Lords as ordinary animals.

Nevertheless, the manifestation of beastkins are the result of the Beast Lords' manipulation of the Terrans' Originium granules.[3] As a matter of fact, those with Oripathy could easily attract a beastkin on their side, or in the other way round, their physical contact with them could easily contract the disease. Whenever they come close to a Terran, the Terran will feel a familiar feeling onto the beastkins.

Due to their origin as fragments of the Beast Lords, the beastkins have obvious differences from typical Terran animals that possess chimeric traits. Breogan once observed that the feathers of a Liberi beastkin, a.k.a., a typical bird from our world, have fundamental differences with a Terran fowlbeast in feather structure; the latter do not possess interlocking barbs but rather membranes resembling Orignium. He also noticed that culturally, the Terrans will treat the beastkins with utter care and refrain from slaughtering them, but the Teekaz race, notably the Sarkaz, treat them as equal as Terran animals, including consuming them as food, and Sarkaz language etymology reveal that they tend to have negative feelings regarding the beastkins.

entries.name: Chimera
entries.content:
A Chimera is stated to be a "primordial method of bringing two as one." Thus, they are hybrids: individuals exhibiting the characteristics of two distinct (and often unrelated) races, although they physically appear as their dominant paternal (and/or likely original) race.

Chimeras are born from either crossbreeding or artificial means (possibly genetic therapy/modifications and/or cloning), the latter of which is regarded as very dangerous. However, what defines a true "Chimera" from a mere offspring of two individuals of different races is still questionable as interracial relationships are common among Terran nations. In fact, it is still unclear that whether the stated methods above could create a "Chimera".

entries.name: Collapsal
entries.content:
Collapsals, called Andskotarnir by the Samifjod, are a collective term for various malevolent extradimensional entities in the world of Arknights as well as entities overtaken by their influence.

The Terrans often called Collapsals Demons, which can led into confusion with the Sarkaz who are sometimes referred to as "demons" in a derogatory sense. Other terms are used as well like Hollows, Wicked Spirits, and Poltergeists.

The unexplored borders of Terra in the north and south are inhabited by various entities that remain unknown to the civilized world, and are considered alien to Terra itself, hence being named "Collapsals" by Columbian researchers who studied them extensively through modern science. They are classified as simultaneously having real and irreal bodies, and it is uncertain if they exist in a conventional sense, with reports noting that they seem unable to interact with the physical world if not being directly perceived or observed; they have been tenuously described as having many strange, grotesque features, such as numerous structures resembling "limbs" and "eyes", and black, foggy, formless bodies. They are considered an infohazard who can gain power and manifest themselves simply by being known, and can seemingly prey on strong emotions such as fear, hence why all Terran nations heavily suppress the passing down of knowledge regarding them, with only the highest authorities of their nations permitted to be aware of their existence.

Collapsals are known to exhibit a certain degree of reality warping and space-time manipulation, in part due to being considered "antithetical" to existence and information; in their presence, conventional physics and understanding breaks down, causing inexplicable phenomena, most commonly in the form of severe physical or cognitive distortion on a widespread scale, often referred to as Collapsal Paradigms. In addition, Collapsals and those corrupted by them can spread a form of pitch-black "contamination", believed to be a result of their projection onto physical space overwriting normal matter. This can be best seen in the form of Dominion.

Although Collapsals do not appear to follow biological or even logical behavior, such as lacking the need to hunt or feed, they are extremely hostile, and will attempt to latch onto and transform both living and inanimate objects even if unprovoked. Collapsals will prey upon their victims through many supernatural methods like mind control, hallucinations, and mirages amidst a blizzard. Entities exposed to Collapsal pollution can also undergo physical and mental corrosion, up to and including total loss of emotion and ego death, while awareness of a Collapsal is sometimes sufficient enough to invite corruption. Individuals who have fully succumbed to Collapse will not only lose all sense of self and become indiscriminately violent, but can also further spread contamination, both through their presence and if another individual contacts or consumes parts of them.

The Collapsals' origin remains unclear, but they are said to came from interdimensional rifts across Terra, most notably a wormhole opened by the "Stargate" in the Infy Icefield, close to the tundras of Sami. In his studies into the "Void" on the other side of reality, or Kargereich as the Leithaniens call it, the Witch King discovered massive Collapsal presence in the dimension, and dedicated much of his efforts into holding them at bay, suggesting they may originate from this space. It is even believed that the Collapsals may be the probes or vanguards of an extradimensional invasion of unknown origin.


Signs of presence
The signs of Collapsal presence can be indicated by the following phenomena:
    1.Blooming plants with no visible roots, especially in the form of flowers. These actually act as anchor points for the Collapsals and can pollute the surrounding area with their influence if not contained.
    2.Pitch black snowfall or the sudden appearance of black fog, a sign of their psychic pollution in certain areas.
    3.Objects resembling human hands such as the Frozen Claw.
    4.Phantom-like beings such as those resembling the Ursine Emperor's Blades.
    5.Blackness that cannot be observed through photography or other optical instruments.

Victims of Collapsal corruption can be noted by the following traits:
    1.Bodies having black patches and being hollowed (i.e., an absence of organs).
    2.Black blood oozing out from their bodies. Sometime stronger entities also produce black snow or fog in their surroundings.
    3.Literal walking dead with abnormal behavior such as extreme convulsion and uncontrolled speed, partially caused by their spatial warping.
    4.Faces becoming a singularity that do not reflect visible light.


Relationship with humans
Since the birth of civilization, mankind has been keeping the Collapsals from invading Terra through their warriors and fortresses stationed at the frigid Infy Icefield and the arid Foehn Hotlands, such as "Emperor's Blades" – Ursine supersoldiers created with Collapsal shards and heavily armored Wendigo armies, Sami Snowpriests born of sacrificial rituals, Yan's most powerful elite Tianshi and soldiers assisted by the city of Yumen and the "Chamber of Heaven's Designs", and the undying Sargonian Zhayedans. The struggle reached its climax at the dawn of the common era a thousand years ago, in Terran year 15, during the world-wide conquest of the Nightzmoran Khagan who drove away all the Collapsals of the Hotlands, thus keeping the south from their presence forever, and set his eyes onto the north before disappearing into history.[14] However, these conflicts often came with a heavy cost such as huge casualties or regions being irreparably corrupted by the Collapsal influences.

In the modern era with thriving technologies, many nations still retain their ancient mindset regarding the Collapsals, except the Columbians who attempt to conduct experiments on them out of scientific curiosity. Nevertheless, without proper precautions, these experiments often end in tragic failures. One example is a research project done by Beachbrella where corrupted meat was fed to animals and resulted in their deaths, upon which they failed to contain the Collapsal pollution, almost leading to a disaster if it weren't for the interference of Typhon and a local Snowpriest.

entries.name: Seaborn
entries.content:
The Seaborn (both singular and plural) are a race of Terra.

The Seaborn are hyper-adaptive aquatic creatures hailing from the abyss of Terra's oceans. They evolve incredibly fast and possess the ability to mutate their own somatic cells without relying on generational heredity. Unlike the Aegir race who also inhabit the oceans, the Seaborn possess a hive mind (more like collective consciousness) called the Many (We Many in their perspective) that they sometimes use to refer to their race as a whole, thus giving them a collective ultimate goal: the survival of their own kin. Even then, sophisticated Seaborn may have partial individuality, allowing them to sever themselves from the Many. Because of their strong adaptivity, they are constantly absorbing new information from the Terrans and use it to further their evolutionary progress. The Seaborn, specifically the Many, are notably worshipped by the cultists of the Church of the Deep as they see it as a utopian goal that could end Terra's never-ending turmoil.


Classification
Based on observations by both Iberian and Aegirian scholars, here are different classifications of the Seaborn with a wide variety of body types, ranging from the lowest Nethersea Brand to more sophisticated Seaborn. These names are sometimes interchangeable when referring to these aquatic beings. Despite their physical and biological differences, all Seaborn are treated as equal under the hivemind, and there have never been observed fighting one another for food.

    1.Nethersea Brand: These are moss-like colonies formed by microscopic Seaborn cells having one goal: acting as culture dishes and providing nourishment for their kin. The Nethersea Brand can grow rapidly and cover entire towns if left unchecked, hence being the toughest being to various Seaborn fighters.
    2.Sea Terror: They are Seaborns ranging from sessile, plantlike, cephalopodic, quadrupedal, to even airborne that behave like ordinary animals. Iberians usually use this name as an umbrella term to all kinds of Seaborn
    3.Sea Monster: As the name suggest, the name refers to monstrous beings that usually possesses gigantic stature and lack both human sentience and animal instinct.
