    4.Seaborn: Rather than being an umbrella term to refers to all kinds of sea monsters, this name is specifically referring to individuals developing human-like intelligence and consciousness who are responsible for spreading new knowledge to their kin. At this stage, it is hard to define whether they are humans or sea monsters. Terrans with Seaborn mixture are also categorized as a true "Seaborn."


Behavior
All Seaborn, whether humanoid or animalistic, are totally equal in the Many.

Due to being linked with the Many, the Seaborn lack the ability to comprehend individualistic concepts such as art, morality, and emotion. In their point of view, gaining individual traits means betraying the Many, and those individualistic Seaborn see this as depriving their own expression even though they try hard to teach them. This also leads to their incapability of telling lies. If being asked, they will express confusion at many concepts such as dishonesty and hatred. Additionally, they are extremely pliable and will act on suggestions without much consideration. In order to protect their kin, they can reduce their bodies to a mass of proteins when being captured, making it nearly impossible to study a living specimen in a research setting. They are even willing to conduct cannibalism amongst themselves simply in the name of "nourishing" their kin.

As the Seaborn's most outstanding trait, their assimilation ability allows them to incorporate other creatures into their ranks. The process begins the moment the Seaborn consume others or the other way round. Their assimilation may also be a slow one which can alter someone physically over due time. Such is common among those who take in Seaborn body parts, whether flesh or tiny cells, and the more being consumed, the greater the alter will be, ranging from partially assimilated (Alfonso), to a full one (Garcia). Retaining human conscience is possible, but it becomes a harder achievement if one almost resembles a true Seaborn. As the Seaborn value unification and assimilation, they can form transactional symbiotic relationships with human communities, as seen in Sal Viento, where they trade food for new members of their horde, and the cultists of the Church in which they provide "sacrifices" for them.

The Seaborn's assimilation process could pose an urgent threat if left unchecked. In order to ensure their own survival, they are not hesitant to devour the whole world through apocalyptic disasters such as sending a world-wide catastrophic tsunami.[4] By the time every creature is assimilated into the Many, they will shift their target onto other planets by departing from their homeland, hence searching for a new habitat and their next victim across the universe.

Seaborn blood can resist the influence of Originium. This is because the ocean lacks said mineral and such influence can be overcome by the Many, especially when one is closer to the ocean that awakes it. As a matter of fact, most Seaborn hybrids are either immune to Oripathy or can suppress their illness even if they become Infected.


Relationship with humans
Forgotten by both the current generation of Terra's civilization and the Seaborn themselves, the Seaborn were originally biological terraforming devices created by the super-advanced spacefaring "Predecessors" that was meant to re-nourish the planet. Their abilities included – surprisingly – removing Originium from the planet and turning the barrenlands into fertile grounds via their nutritious biochemicals. However, the project was ultimately thwarted due to the "disaster" from the sky that wiped out the prior civilization. Their artificial origin is further proven by numerous underwater ancient ruins that were formerly Seaborn creation laboratories.
Despite the uncertain, grim future, humanity has striven to defend their homeland against the abyss for generations, whether the sea or the land

Originally, the Seaborn had no antagonism against mankind, to a point that even ancient Iberians managed to make jewelry out of their body parts despite not knowing their nature. In fact, Iberia's encounter with the Seaborn date as early as centuries ago when they started to appear in the coastlines. Their strange shapes and eldritch nature evoked the Iberians' imagination, hence drawing their interest.

The modern Seaborn crisis only began around the nineth Terran century when the Seaborn was awoken by Mártus the Aegirian sage, the spiritual leader of the Church of the Deep who uncovered the source of the Seaborn, received revelation regarding them, and quietly introducing them into Aegiran cities to begin the assimilation process. In the beginning, Aegir did not pay attention to the Seaborn but treated them as mere invasive "kelp-farm pests." But within a few months, these early Seaborn evolved drastically and became a hazard to the Aegirian defense. The sudden appearance of the Seaborn forced the Aegirians to reevaluate their strategies by identifying them as a whole new marine species who are on par with humans. As the Seaborn expanded their territories upon Aegir settlements, many Aegirian refugees were forced to flee on land, but along with them came with the followers of the Deep who sought to assimilate the land-dwellers into the Seaborn's hivemind.

A few years before the Profound Silence of 1038, the Seaborn's activities became more prominent on land, but many Iberians did not realize their danger. Iberian collectors were still fascinated over ornaments made of Seaborn parts; children near the coastlines had the habit of treating Seaborn as toys; even the King of Iberia sought to capture a five-meter-long Seaborn to sculpt it into a huge fountain in front of his palace. Even though many Aegirian sages sternly warned the Iberian royal house of the Seaborn's danger, the King of Iberia was more fascinated over the legends of the Church of the Deep. Consequently, the Iberians' neglection over the Seaborn led to the destructive tsunamis of the Profound Silence that wiped out their palace and half of their land, and Aegir's communication with the land was abruptly severed due to Seaborn infestation. In the present days, the Iberian Inquisition stubbornly refuses to reveal the existence of the Seaborn to Terra's land-dwellers, as they see themselves as the land's final frontline against those monsters.

In an effort of retaliation, Aegir has experimented on several different methods to eliminate the Many. This lead to the creation of the Abyssal Hunters, a band of Aegir-Seaborn hybrid supersoldiers. But, because they are infused with Seaborn blood, all Abyssal Hunters are viewed as brothers and sisters by the Seaborn, who harbor no ill will towards them. However, less intelligent Seaborn mistake the Hunters' bodies as prisons for their kin, thus attacking them with hostility in an attempt to free the blood within and nourish their kin.

entries.name: |----------FRACTIONS----------|
entries.content: Terra, is comprised of many factions, whether nation-states, corporations, or independent groups, with their own interests and goals.

entries.name: -----Aegir-----
entries.content:
Aegir, stylized as Ægir, is a Terran country that encompasses the vast, uncharted ocean from the southern coastlines of Iberia, and it is the homeland of the Aegir race. A super-advanced technocracy, Aegir adopts unique political and social structures that are completely alien to the land-dwellers. Rather than having a unified head of state, each Aegirian city is ruled by a consul and their technocratic officers who assign their social roles to their citizens.

Aegir has always been a highly advanced society for millenia owing to their inheritance of the lost technologies from the "Predecessors". As a matter of fact, the Aegirians have surpassed all the known Terran civilizations in many areas to a point that they are even developing themselves to become an interstellar civilization, and this makes them strongly despise the land dwellers' "primitivism." But around two hundred years ago, an excavation mission accidentally awoke the Seaborn, forcing Aegir to postpone much of their projects to face the threat. To further deteriorate the situation, the cultic Church of the Deep has slowly infiltrated the government and persuaded them to "coexist" with the Seaborn. In the modern era, Aegir has continued to eradicate the Seaborn threat but refused to seek cooperation with the land-dwellers up until recent years.

Throughout most of history, many land-dwellers believed Aegir to be a fictional country. Academic documentation of Aegir only appeared during the 9th Terran century when Aegirian refugees settled around the southern coastlines of Iberia. Known as the "Islanders", their contribution paved the road for Iberia's Golden Age, but after the Profound Silence of 1038, nearly all traces of Aegir vanished, with communication to the country severed by a tsunami. Only a handful of academicians and scholars study Aegir through the few surviving records and manuscripts stored in old libraries.

entries.name: Abyssal Hunters
entries.content:
he Abyssal Hunters are a Terran organization. They are a band of Aegirian supersoldiers composing of Aegir-Seaborn hybrids whose mission is to keep the Seaborn in check and prevent their invasion of the land. Their eerie background makes them both mysterious and dangerous to the land-dwellers of Terra. 


Background
The conception of the Abyssal Hunter could be traced back to the ninth Terran century in the early stage of the Seaborn crisis. Ekladious, a Consul of the Institute of Societal and Administrative Supervision, had suffered from diseases due to his old age, and he believed that genetic modification on humans was the only way to make them perfect in order to protect their homeland from the Seaborn. However, Aegir had long been holding the belief that genetic modification is the greatest taboo that could usurp their long-adorned humanistic value; many perceive that a perfect, healthy man is not a robot that can be simply replaced by machinery parts. In turn, Ekladious argued that Aegir is running out of time from the Seaborn invasion as these monsters are not just pesky invasive pests but a whole new lifeform that could greatly alter their environment. Ekladious’ proposal eventually did not come into being due to pressures from his colleagues and family, and he responded to his failure by formally resigning from his office.

For the next two centuries, there had been heated debates over weaponization of genetic modification. It was only in the most recent twenty years in the 1080s when the Aegirian consuls finally gave a green light in conducting bio-engineering weapons to respond to the ever-increasing threat from the Seaborn, and Ulpianus volunteered to become the first subject in the experiment.[2] Through perfect technologies, these chosen subjects became the "Abyssal Hunters" Many were amazed by their technological supremacy to create a perfect hybrid, while others remain skeptical that Aegir is willing to sacrifice its value in exchange to create these "monsters." Even the Aegirian military remained highly cautious over the Abyssal Hunters by supervising them and killing them when necessary if they went rampage.

In 1095, Aegir managed to identify a Leviathan named "Ishar-mla." With full preparation, they unleashed its entire Abyssal Hunters force to destroy It in hope to end the Seaborn crisis once and for all. However, Aegir underestimated the number of the Leviathans, and the battle resulted in the total annihilation of the Abyssal Hunters. During that tragic battle, the First and Fourth Squads were immediately destroyed by the wave of Seaborn, and others quickly went missing in action, leaving only the Second Squad ambushing in their nest. The battle in Its nests was described more as a deadly "feast" to the Seaborn to bait them out of the nests. Despite succeeding in delivering a fatal blow upon Ishar-mla, none of the warriors survived from the aftermath. Given its severe casualties, Aegir quickly shut down the Abyssal Hunter project and shifted towards other methods in repealing the Seaborn.

In 1100, after five years of missing, the surviving Abyssal Hunters finally returned to Aegir, bringing surprising news to many Aegirians. Nevertheless, they keep suspicion over the Aegirian Consuls as they have uncovered that their government bodies have long been infiltrated by the nefarious Church of the Deep.


Organization
The Abyssal Hunters consist of Aegir-Seaborn hybrid "super soldiers" created by the Aegirians as a countermeasure against the Seaborn, hence its name that derives from the Seaborn's origin.[3] The process of creating Abyssal Hunters contains many different advanced procedures, and the candidates are chosen from among the whole Aegir population, regardless of their previous status or occupation.

Abyssal Hunters possess unusually high physical strength, endurance, and speed, far surpassing regular Terrans. Their physical and psychological engineering is necessary to withstand the Seaborn's might and horror. They exclusively use "primitive" melee weapons to emphasize their physical prowess as well as preventing their enemies from evolving countermeasures against their advanced technologies. Unfortunately, a hunter’s Seaborn blood can overtake their Aegir blood if left unchecked, which can lead to their transformation into the monsters they despise. Symptoms of such transformation include lack of awareness for their surroundings, loss of consciousness, and Seaborn scales occupying their bodies.

Aside from their unimaginable strength and stamina, all known Abyssal Hunters possess white hair and red eyes, likely a sign of a successful merge with the Seaborn. However, Andreana, another hunter, lacks the traits listed above. And as such, is treated as a failed product; it is hinted that she might have been created by the notorious Church of the Deep. Abyssal Hunters are also entirely incapable of using Originium Arts, unlike normal Aegir people, as a result of their hybridization with the Seaborn.

entries.name: -----Bolivar-----
entries.content:
Bolívar is a Terran country bordering both Columbia in the east and Sargon in the south. It is a nation inhabited by small-sized races, predominantly the Perros, with limited self-defense capabilities while possessing rich Originium deposits, but its abundant natural resources result in the fracturing of the nation into three warring factions. Currently, Bolívar is partitioned into two de facto independent states ruled by their respective factions: the Kingdom of Bolívar in the west that is ruled by a classical monarchy and the Sovereign State of Bolívar in the east being run by an oligarchy, and the third faction consists of liberated zones freed by local guerrillas but being under the rule of an authoritarian military junta.

Bolívar was founded as a colonial viceroyalty of Iberia established in the once unexplored northwestern region of Terra, triggering other superpowers to set up their colonies in the region, However, the increasing geopolitical pressure from rivaling nations forced Iberia to hesitantly abandon the colony and declare its independence. But Bolívar's independence was short-lived with the collapse of its government which allowed Leithanien to interfere in its internal affairs and convert the nation into its puppet state. The independence of Columbia further fractured Bolívar as the Columbian government asserted political influence upon its neighbor, resulting in a proxy war between the two superpowers. The war eventually gave rise to a local resistance force fighting against the imperialist forces, yet their extreme disorganization and brute force upon the populace further dragged Bolívar into a seemingly never-ending stalemate.

The Bolívarian language resembles Latin American Spanish in our world while having distinct grammars and accents even though both are mutually intelligible enough with each other. Victorian, Columbian, and Leithanian are also three of the most spoken languages in the nation as a result of foreign intervention.

entries.name: Bolivar: Administration and politics
entries.content:
Singas dynasty

The Singas dynasty is a dynastic absolute monarchy ruling the Kingdom of Bolívar headquartered in the royal capital of Gran Sinderacato. Being the longest-standing regime since its establishment in the year 898, the Singas are supported by the Leithanian Imperial Court as a puppet regime, although its domain over the country is at most nominal. To retain the suzerainty, the Singas need to pay annual tributes to Leithanien from Originium ores, food supplies, manpower to finances; in turn, Leithanien asserts its political and cultural influences upon the kingdom from setting up Leithanian as the national language to promoting local tourism to Leithanian aristocrats.

In many ways, the Singas duplicates the exact political system from Leithanien, from a king of hereditary succession, courtiers serving the royal court, to a rigid aristocratic hierarchy. On the other hand, the Bolívarian hierarchy lacks the mutual aid and compromise characteristics of the nine Kurfürsten of Leithanien. Excluding the Kurfürsten, the Kingdom of Bolívar implements a six-level hierarchy with their respective political roles:

    King
    Duke
    Marquess
    Count
    Viscount
    Baron

The Singas are often criticized for their chaotic, mismanaged government, and their influence over the country is even said to be minimal. The further one stays from the royal capital of Gran Sinderacato, the lesser one would recognize themselves as the citizen of the kingdom. Furthermore, corruption and injustice are habitual problems within the Singas-controlled areas. Nevertheless, With better infrastructure and mediocre executions in its rule, the Singas are able to retain their power in their jurisdiction for almost two centuries despite the chaotic civil war.

The Singas dynasty is likely inspired by the First and Second Mexican Empires, the latter of which was a puppet state of France, and the more successful Brazilian Empire. It may also be a reference to Klein-Venedig, the most important German colony in Latin America which occupied territories of both Venezuela and Colombia.


Coalition Government
The Bolívarian Coalition Government, or the Coalition for short, is an authoritarian political party ruling the Sovereign State of Bolívar from the capital of La Unidad. The Coalition had its roots from several Bolívarian warlords and tycoons seeking covert aid from Columbia since the Revolutionary War of 1019 who yearned to liberate the country from Leithanian rule by converting their territories as Columbian enclaves. Following the Witch King's provocation upon Columbian soil, the Coalition was formally founded in 1048, and they have since been receiving constant banking and manpower from the Columbian Federal Government even though they have been heavily criticized for their incompetence in enhancing Columbian investments.

Described as a "parliamentary oligarchy," the Coalition's Government is headed by a unicameral legislature, the Supreme Council of Bolívar (Consejo Supremo de Bolívar), consisting of fifteen oligarchs having a permanent seat in the government. These oligarchs are made up of the most powerful and resourceful people in the Sovereign State, many of whom being plutocratic financial cliques and military leaders. While having absolute power to the publics' eyes, decision making is often done by voting among the oligarchs. Because the oligarchs' seats are permanent, it can only be succeeded either when the previous oligarchs passes away or when they voluntarily resign. Consequently, murder attempts and blackmailing are a norm within the Supreme Council.

In some ways, the Coalition is more fragile than the corrupted Singas dynasty. It has been a public secret that the oligarchs of the Supreme Council have attempted to unify the country under one-man leadership but ended in demise due to internal struggles among the oligarchs and Columbia's interference. Furthermore, Columbia refuses to treat the Coalition equally in terms of diplomacy, and any rebellion against the Columbian government will be quickly suppressed. As a consequence, the Coalition's stability heavily relies on Columbia's support unlike the Singas that could make independent decisions.


True Bolívarians
The True Bolivarian Liberation Movement , or the True Bolivarians (T.B.) for short, is a military junta founded by several local guerrilla resistance forces banding together under a common name in the year 1050 who oppose both the imperialist powers and their proxies in their homeland. Consequently, T.B. is officially labeled as a "terrorist organization" by both the Singas and the Coalition Government, and T.B. responds by giving the same title to these two "illegitimate" regimes. Despite sharing a common goal, these resistance forces possess different ideologies when it comes to implementing a new government system. This is more evident in the three major parties leading the junta:
    1.The Bolivarian Rescue Frontline that seeks to end the civil war and expel their respective puppet regimes, but being a conformist party that wants to retain the current political structure.
    2.The Bolivarian Youth Party that aims to rebuild the political structure by setting up a socialistic parliamentary system through moderate means.
    3.The Bolivarian Resistance Alliance, an extreme anarchist party heavily influenced by the Rusthammers that seeks to abolish all forms of central government.

Owing to their military root, T.B. is solely run by commanders-in-chief of respective resistance forces who are both the legislative and executive bodies. Strict orders and a well-defined military rank among the subordinates allow T.B. to execute their order immediately in times of crises. Territories ruled by T.B., called "liberated zones" in their words, often implement martial laws given by the junta throughout the years with only some relaxed control during festival seasons.

On the outside, T.B. are praised for their bravery in facing the imperialist powers and their heroic idealism to rebuild their homeland. But to those Bolivarians who live under their rule, they are the symbol of a reign of terror. Because T.B. does not share a common ideology, many of their troops conduct their missions on their own without proper leadership. Furthermore, the violent anarchism carried by the Bolivarian Resistance Alliance often results in severe humanitarian crises. They implement a scorched-earth policy upon captured territories in which they will mercilessly destroy local infrastructures and settlements, and in some cases, they will even conduct massacres upon the occupied populace in the name of "executing treacherous fouls." Between 1050 to 1060, the total captured territories that were destroyed by T.B. could have been provided as settlements for an estimated 300,000 Bolivarian refugees. Even though the current leading party of T.B. is the much more moderate Bolivarian Youth Party that has greatly decreased the junta's inhumane campaigns in recent decades, T.B. never vows to give up their extreme violence upon their enemies and occupied populaces.


Military
The Singas Army is the military of the Kingdom of Bolívar under the direct command of both the Singas dynasty and Leithanien. The kingdom implements a compulsory military service upon every citizen regardless of race, gender, or social status, and they must spend at least three years in military academies to finish their service. Occasionally, Leithanien dispatches commanders-in-chief and exchange students to serve in the Shingas Army not only to serve them, but also have them directly earning their combat experience in various battlefields. At one time, Leithanien's military support was temporarily halted during the Witch King's proxy war against Columbia in terms of military command, but it was eventually restored following the ascension of the Twin Empresses in 1077. Hence, the Shingas Army presents a drastic contrast in professionalism, resources, and training compared to the other warring factions that are mainly composed of undisciplined troops.

The Coalition Army of the Sovereign State, on the other hand, heavily relies on imported foreign military equipment and a conscription system in which the oligarchs could even pay ordinary civilians to be recruited in the army. Retired soldiers from various countries are also hired by the Coalition at high cost to work as drill instructors, but many of these instructors possess different and sometimes opposite military tactics that could confuse new recruits. Thus, a shambled military instruction is the main reason for the lawlessness and a lack of combat experience among the Coalition's army. Nevertheless, the Coalition Government cultivates the Bolívarian National Guards as a separate military entity, and the army is composed of elite soldiers who mainly serve as military policemen.

Due to its never-ending civil war, Bolívar has been inventing various military weapons, one of which are the "hounds" that were first deployed in this country. Even though they are widely used by mercenaries across Terra due to their convenience, some Perros strongly disagree with such a method. While the exact origins of the "hounds" are unknown, rumors say that they were created as part of supposed national "secret experiments" conducted behind the scenes by using a captured Beast Lord as a basis. These rumors, however, are unconfirmed.

entries.name: Bolivar: Geography
entries.content:
Bolívar's topography is made up of the elevated highlands bordering the in the north, the central grassland, and lowland tropical rainforests in the south. Most Bolívarians live in the central plains, and they colloquially call the northern highlands and the southern rainforest as the "borders."

The northern highlands, called the Bolívarian Border Plateau, are made up of arid plateaus near the Sea of Norlett that are covered by deserts and shrublands, and the northern plateau composes 20% of the Bolívarian land. Because of its arid climate with little precipitation and drastic day-night temperature, the plateaus is an unsuitable place for human settlements. Nevertheless, cactus and melon cultivation is prominent in the region.

The central region of Bolívar is the famous Bolívarian Plain. A vast sub-saharan grassland with fertile soil and abundant natural resources, the region is historically the ideal spot for colonial settlements Bolívar during the age of exploration. Furthermore, the Bolívarian Plain is famous for its rich mineral deposits, notably Originium ores; the Kollosal Prime Vein, one of three Originium prime veins in Terra, traverses the entire plain from the southwest to the northeast. Hence, more than 90% of the Bolívarian population could be found in the central region.

The southern rainforest of Bolívar is given the name the Black Flow. The Black Flow shares similarities with neighboring rainforests in the Vouivre Alliance of Sargon: a lush tropical rainforest with towering tree canopies that could block sunlight. Heavy rainfall often occurs in the afternoon which in turn creates several kilometer-long gushing rivers, hence the name. Because of its complex geography, the southern rainforest is sparsely inhabited.


Economy
Despite the ongoing civil war, Bolívar's economy is surprisingly stable thanks to its core economic activities, agriculture and mining industry. Thanks to the fertile soil and flat topography of the central plain, agriculture in Bolívar is relatively advanced. In fact, according to historical records, Francisco de León once remarked that its fertility could even grow an abundant crop by "simply scattering a handful of seeds" with little to no effort. Due to climate differences, agricultural practices differ depending on the region: the north is known for the cultivation of melons, beets, and even cactuses, whereas the south is dominated by coffee plants and sugar canes. Plantations of all sizes can be found all across the country, but the practice can be very unfair to many Bolívarians. This is because plantation owners usually hire workers at a very low cost as cheap labor, and much of the produced goods are exported to various superpowers, notably Leithanien and Columbia, which in turn leaves many local consumers to meet an expensive price for their local products. As in its mineral industry, Bolívar mainly extracts Originium, copper and iron ores as well as gemstones in the central plain. The abundant resources of the central plain is the main reason for ongoing conflicts among various warring factions, be it the three Bolívarian factions or foreign superpowers.

The Bolívarian civil war also gives rise to its prominent mercenary industry. The three warring factions usually employ neutral paramilitary units from all over Terra such as Blacksteel, and they offer a lucrative bounty to their mercenaries through military campaigns. As these mercenaries spend a large sum of money in Bolívar through their reward they earn, the vitality of Bolívar's economy is greatly increased which in turn brings economic development in various undeveloped regions. Nevertheless, the ethics of such industry is still questionable as these mercenaries earn their lives at the cost of others' lives.


Demographics
Bolívar has a total population of 16,000,000 people summing up all the populace of the respective three factions, and almost all the population live in the central plain. The nation is predominated by the Perro race, one the common Terran races across the continent, but other races could be found such as common Terran races like Zalaks and Felines, races coming from neighboring countries such as Savrans, Durins, and Vouivres from Sargon as well as Liberi from Iberia and Columbia, and finally some rare races like Anuras from the southern rainforest.

entries.name: Bolivar: Culture
entries.content: Contrary to the negative public perception that Bolívar is a poor, war-torn country, Bolívar actually has a vibrant culture that is mainly found in undisturbed cities. Even though most Bolívarians are illiterate and do not receive proper education, they can master more than two to three languages, ranging from local Bolívarian, Victorian, Columbian, to Leithanian. Owing to its multicultural background as the first Terran colony in an unexplored region, many cultures have blended well in Bolívar, be it Iberian, Victorian, Gaulish, Columbian, Leithanian, and even Sargonian. Hence, Bolívarian art is famous for its literary works and a variant style of music having its roots from Iberian folksongs and Leithanian classical music. Notably, Bolívarian literary works have the theme of war fiction that solely focus on political reality, exposures of corruption and social inequality, and the suffering of commoners throughout the war.

entries.name: Bolivar: The Infected
entries.content:
Due to the ongoing civil war, Bolívar is also one of the countries that experience persecutions upon the Infected populace, be it the Singas dynasty, the Coalition Government, and the True Bolívarians. Both the Singas and the Coalition jurisdictions implement similar policies with Leithanien and Columbia respectively, whereas the True Bolívarians often conduct purges in their "liberated zones" in the name of "executing treacherous fouls."

On the other hand, Dossoles, the de jure capital of Bolívar that remains neutral throughout the civil war, is one of the very few places in Bolívar where Infected are not heavily persecuted. Nevertheless, even though they are allowed to enter and live in the city, they are segregated from the population through specific bars, casinos, etc, that also only for the Infected.

entries.name: -----Columbia-----
entries.content:
Columbia, formally known as the Columbian Union, is a Terran country located on the northwestern corner of the continent bordering Ursus, Kazimierz, Sami, Sargon, and Bolívar. It is a federal presidential republic governed by a national government under a modern democratic institution with separated three branches: legislative, executive, and judicial, though the executive branch has long been occupied by its one and only president, President Mark Max, who is constantly elected back to the office due to popularity, which further weakens the supposed democracy that limits the power of a head of state.

As the youngest geopolitical superpower on Terra, Columbia is a melting pot of various races and cultures. The nation begins from a Victorian colony in the region that declared its independence under Gaulish support. Following its victory in the war for independence, Columbia continues to expand westward while accelerating in scientific progress, military capability, cultural and ideological exports, and economy. However, Columbia's increasing expansionism through incentive migrations of frontier pioneers and interventionism has led to its direct conflict against neighboring Bolívar and its extensive political influences upon other countries such as Sargon and Sami, and it has recently invested in an arm race to further exert its power upon other Terran superpowers through superiority in military.

Columbia proclaims itself to be a nation of "equity" where everyone, including the Infected and even the Sarkaz, is treated equally and could realize their dreams. On one hand, its treatment of minorities is indeed much better than other countries'. However, the nation is secretly exploiting the Infected, the local Sarkaz community, and the commoners by enticing them to settle in the country's wastelands as its first pioneers, where Catastrophes are common, crime is rampant, and the land is yet undeveloped. These pioneers have been on the frontline of Columbia's territorial expansion.

entries.name: Columbia: Administration and politics
entries.content:
Administration and politics

Government of Columbia

Columbia is a federal republic that practices a presidential democracy unlike other nations that are ruled by monarchs, churches, or oligarchs. According to Columbian tradition, such a revolutionary system was first proposed by the founding father of Columbia, Maylander Selene, in which he believed a federal republic that is more stronger than city-state confederation would be able to resist political threats from other superpowers, notably Victoria and Gaul. Mark Max too agreed that a presidential system that replaced the former Victorian Royal Governor could preserve self-governing among the colonial settlements as well as giving the voting rights to the citizens to elect their head of state.

The Columbian democratic system creates a separation of power between the executive, the legislative, and the judiciary. In the executive body, there are two government entities: the federal government at the capital of Max D.C. led by both the President and the Vice President, and the state governments ruling the states from their respective nomadic cities. The national government is further divided into three essential entities: the Federal Executive Departments, the Union Congress, and the Department of Defense.

While on paper and to the eyes of the outside world, Columbia is practicing a democracy, in reality, it is composed of various political schemes that makes its government appear to be more like a plutocratic oligarchy in practice in order to cover up the nation's true secrets. Following the war for independence, Maylander the founding father has been hiding himself behind the political scene by setting up a "deep state" organization later known as the Maylander Foundation which serves as the national intelligence agency. Despite the nation being run by the President democratically, surprisingly, there is a lack of a term limit for its one and only President since the nation's foundation – President Mark Max – due to his extreme popularity that never falls throughout decades. As a matter of fact, the Columbians are fine for President Max to stay in his office as long as he wishes without realizing his real nature, for they believe Max is the living national icon of Columbia. In turn, it is the Vice President who carries out the will of President Max, and this position is subject to general elections once finishing their term.


The Federal Government
The Federal Government (often nicknamed "the Fed") is the national government and the executive body of Columbia organized by various Federal Executive Departments. The President is the leader of every department, forming a three-level hierarchy from the President, the Cabinet, to the departments. The Cabinet of Columbia is led by the Vice President, Secretaries of Departments, and Counselor to the President who form an elite group assisting the President in making high-level decisions. Each Executive Department, in turn, is specialized in many fields to run the country.

    Department of State
    Department of Treasury
    Department of Defense
    Department of Justice
    Department of Agriculture
    Department of Commerce


Union Congress
The Union Congress, full name the Columbian Free City Union Congress, is the legislative body of Columbia . Its functions consist of formulating federal laws, overseeing the Federal Executive Departments, and representing the will of Columbian citizens. It also has complete authority to reject any motions from the Departments and begin the impeachment process of any federal politician.

The Union Congress' structure draws inspiration from the bicameral system of the Victorian Parliament in which it is divided into the Senate and the House of Representatives. The Senate is headed by the Vice President as the President of the Senate, and the Senators represent the interests of the states and nomadic cities alike. On the other hand, the Speaker of the Representatives is elected by the Representatives who have connections with diverse social institutions and business groups from all over Columbia.
Government agencies

    Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Arts Units and Originium (ATAO): The law enforcement organization of the Columbian government. It specifically regulates the manufacture and import of Arts units and Originium devices. Behind the scenes however, ATAO is trying to arouse conflicts within Sargon in order to earn profit through bloodshed.[4] ATAO alludes to the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, and Firearms (ATF) in real world.
    Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC): A national agency tasked with ensuring public health, as well as prevention and control of diseases. They have a toxicity database containing hazard levels of various materials such as Originium.
    Columbian Custom and Border Protection (CBP): A federal agency that safeguards the country's borders and regulates customs activity.
    The Columbian Tax Bureau headquarters in Bunkerhill City
    Columbian Tax Bureau: A federal agency that administers internal revenue from individuals and companies within the country, headquartered in the city of Bunkerhill. At one point, they arrested Big Bob for alleged tax and insurance evasion, as many of his employees were Infected individuals who had not even received their monthly insurance premium payments from him, thus violating Bunkerhill's laws. They later tried to excoriate him for money laundering.


Judiciary
The judiciary body of Columbia is divided into two entities similar to the executive body: the Union Supreme Court of Justice and the District Courts. The Supreme Court possesses final appellate jurisdiction over all cases within the federal territory, whereas District Courts determine all citizen and criminal actions within a specific region based on the state laws. In law enforcement, specialized agencies from the Federal Executive Departments, such as the ATAO, enforce federal laws, but municipal or state laws, on the other hand, are enforced by local law enforcement groups organized by nomadic cities or states. In case of cross-state of foreign-related crimes or crimes that involve the federal government, federal agents and/or task forces will be dispatched to directly intervene, or even take over the investigation by assigning law enforcement.[9]

The constitution of Columbia is based on the Articles of Confederation signed in 1019. This document not only represents the most important instrument in the Columbian judiciary, but also sets up a standard in making new laws based on legal precedents and the Supreme Court's guides.


Military
Recruitment posters for the Union Army. Along with the classical mascot of President Max, powersuits armed with latest technologies have been recently used to attract public attention.

The Union Army is the national defense of Columbia. Despite its incompatibility with its relatively small population, Columbia maintained a professional army since the Revolutionary War, and one out of five citizens are former personnel serving the Union Army. The Union Army's spiritual predecessor was the Duke Canon Gododdin's pioneer army who served as the main rebel force against Duke Tybalt's offensive during the Revolutionary War. After Columbia's independence, they were regarded as a representative of federal heroism and independent spirit, and their leaders have become high-ranking leaders in the DOD.

The modern Union Army's main strategy is the "Preemptive Contention" proposed in 1058 after the Preparation Act. This strategy consists of mobilizing all Columbian armed forces and implementing multi-level proactive intervention in hotspot areas that are no longer restricted to military means, aiming to curb the threat of potential war in advance and further ensuring the federal defense. Ever since its approval from the President and the Congress, it has become the Union Army's first choice of basic national strategy for nearly half a century, and has proven to be effective in the Sargonian and Bolívarian battlefields.

Thanks to the "Preemptive Contention," the Union Army focuses more on improving precise strategic targeting while preventing Columbia from falling into another full-scale war. Such enables Columbia to develop a flexible army formed by both the national defense and private mercenary companies. The Union Army will focus more on technological support while the mercenaries cover on-the-ground combat and cover support under their contracts.


Department of Defense
The Columbian Union Department of Defense (C.U.D.O.D. or DOD for short) is a Federal Executive Department that oversees the nation's defense force while being relatively independent in the executive body without the interference of other Secretaries of Department. It has the power to mobilize all federal military forces whenever the President declares a state of war. As a matter of fact, the DOD is often considered a separate entity in the Columbian Federal Government.

Due to its relative independence, the DOD has been in disagreement with the Federal Government for years. Unlike other departments, the DOD firmly believes in "might makes right" and yearns to expand Columbia's influence through the military. Prior to 1056, the de facto Commander-in-Chief of the Union Army was the Secretary of Defense who even had the power in handling foreign affairs. However, following the failed invasion of Bolívar in the late 40s and the incompetence of the Coalition Government, the DOD completely fell from grace in both the Federal Government and the public, causing the department to be heavily criticized within the military. This forced the leading Secretary of Defense to make concessions to the President and the Congress in regards to the DOD's rights. Furthermore, the Federal War Preparation Act passed by the Congress in 1056 even completely restrained the military's power and responsibilities after the secretary's seat and the command rights were handed back to the President.

In order to regain favor in the Federal Government, the DOD has been starting to look for business cooperation with many technological corporations, i.e., Rhine Lab and Volvort Kochinski, in exchange for the latest technologies for military applications. Following the Victorian Crisis, the DOD reaffirms their decision, fearing that they will be overpowered by superweapons like the Shard. The DOD's influence could be found in many programs and scientific misconduct incidents such as "Project Diαbolic," the "Loken Watertank Incident," and the "Horizon Arc Project."

entries.name: Columbia: Geography
entries.content:
Columbia is located in the northwestern corner of Terra bordering Bolívar to the west and Kazimierz to the east, and its land mass is similar to modern-day Victoria. Columbian biomes are made up of arid deserts in the east, the sub-temperate fertile lowlands in the center filled with rivers and lakes that flow northward, and arid shrublands of the west as part of the Bolívarian plain's easternmost corner that surrounds the coasts of the inland Sea of Norlett in the north.

The deserts of the east are formed by blockade of moist wind from Victoria by the Kjeragian mountain ranges, but it also contains habitable grasslands and valleys. Many large lakes forming oases dotting the region could also be found in the region that is known as the Great Lakes region. Towards the southernmost border of Columbia facing Sargon is the desolate Bleached Wasteland that is covered by only gray sands and Originium shards.

While western Columbia is an arid prairie, human activities can be found in the regions, notably settlements of frontier pioneers. The region is right above the passing Kolossal Prime Vein, hence, western Columbia possesses the most concentrations of Originium deposits in the country.

As part of Columbia's expansion of territories, human settlements could be found both on the eastern deserts and the western shrublands, which are nicknamed "wastelands" by settling frontier pioneers.


Economy
Spanning in all fields, Columbian corporations are both pioneers of latest technology and science and rich entrepreneurs. Notably, trades and technological industries are the heart of Columbia's economy. Since the Revolutionary War, Columbia had established a transborder trading route from Bolívar to Kazimierz after making political deals with the Shingas dynasty and Kazimierzian merchants. In turn, Columbia uses this route as a way to assert political and cultural influences upon both countries. By turning both countries as its springboard, Columbian corporations could be found in almost every corner of Terra.

Columbian technological advancement is seen as a miracle to many Terran nations. Many superpowers did not expect this once mere Victorian colony in the barrenlands suddenly arose to become the leader of science and technology within almost a century. With leading corporations such as Rhine Lab and Raythean, Columbia could maintain its technological supremacy in Terra in the long term. In the meantime, Columbia manages to capitalize these inventions and earns lucrative income by exporting them to other nations, forming the foundation of Columbia's economy.

Despite Columbia's advancement in technologies and its economic prosperity, they seem to not affect the vast commonfolk financially, and social inequality is still present in Columbia. Plutocracy is the norm among Columbian corporations while they assert their influence upon the federal government. Some large companies even practice lobbying and bribery to gain favor from government servants, implement laws that are favorable to their business, and secret collaborations with the Federal Government as in the case of the infamous Mama John's "Doughnut Case." Even though the Columbian government encourages everyone to become entrepreneurs, much of the income eventually falls into the pockets of the rich, while smaller businesses that met their utter bankruptcy are forced to become frontier pioneers to pay their debt.


Demographics
Columbia has a total population of 16,000,000 people based on a national census in 1083, with about half of whom living in nomadic cities. However, due to its large-scale pioneering efforts and frequent immigration, the number of citizens has been rising at a constant yet accelerating rate.

As a result of the constant rates of immigration, Columbia possesses a large racial diversity, ranging from common races like Felines and Perros to less populated ones such as Phidians and Savrans. However, a considerable amount of the Columbian population is composed of Liberi, which are descended from immigrants from around the world, especially from Gaul since the War of the Four Nations. According to a Liberi immigrant census published by Columbian authorities, the reason why many of them decide to settle in Columbia is not only for the possibility of starting a new life, but also the popularity that Mark Max has on the Liberi community.

To many Columbians, they have negative viewpoints regarding Lupo immigrants from Siracusa and the Sarkaz communities. The former are often viewed as mafia members as many of whom have roots in larger famiglie such as Famiglia Texas. Especially since the Revolutionary War, many of these famiglie were engaged in illicit actions such as smuggling and underground gambling despite the Columbian government's tolerance, and the Columbian government even used the excuse of curbing Siracusan smuggling to Bolívar to interfere in Bolívar's politics.[19] The latter are mostly refugees who fled from Kazdel before and after the eastern crusades of 898, and many of them dwell among the lower class such as slums and frontier settlements. Like any Terran nation, they are subject to constant discrimination and exploitation; local pro-Sarkaz social movements are few and far between.

entries.name: Columbia: Culture
entries.content:
As a melting pot, Columbian culture is an amalgamation of various cultures of different countries and races from cuisines of Victorian, Taran, and Bolívarian immigrants, religions of the Iberians, Laterans, and the Sarkaz, to classical Ursine, Leithanian and Gaulish arts. These cultures combine into the vibrant modern culture of Columbia praised across Terra that even the conservatives have begun to experience such a culture shock. As Columbia actively exports its soft power, some nations have been strongly shaped by its culture and ideology in turn such as Siracusa's adoption of Columbian judiciary system and Kazimierzian economy that is greatly influenced by Columbian commercialism.

In Columbia, a standard of accepting one culture into the mainstream Columbian society is whether they could be integrated into parts of the Columbian popular culture. In turn, the Columbian art community is famous for adoption of various different elements from different cultures and backgrounds. Under the support of the government, Columbia converts these arts and cultures into streamline industries such as Wrankwood movies, pop music, new types of sports like baseball, and fast food restaurants.

Because Columbia is a nation of immigrants, prior to its colonial era, conflicts between various races and nationalities was a norm due to cultural differences. In order to unite the citizens under one banner, the federal government has initiated a "cultural war" behind the scene by supporting "the most excellent Columbian culture," notably pop cultures and liberal ideologies, while indirectly encouraging youngsters to belittle other foreign cultures. Within two generations, young Columbians actively embrace the modern Columbian culture, and conflicts among communities decrease over the years. On the other hand, these new generations start to vent out their ideologies akin to liberal progressivism and so-called "woke culture" in which they target other communities who refuse to embrace modern culture, resulting in an accumulating tension between the conservatives and the liberals.


Frontier pioneers
Owing to its colonial origin, the frontier pioneers are still an integral part of Columbia both culturally and politically. Many of these pioneers are made up of Infected citizens or the illiterate lower class, including middle-aged couples drowned in debts, young people with nothing to do, and inmates who're given the opportunity to serve their sentence without being jailed. As provided by the Articles of Confederation, the Infected are granted citizenship as a reward for their contribution in the Revolutionary War, but they need to pay a huge sum of premium insurance in order to live normally among others, or else they will be forced to be moved to slum-like quarantine zones, and those who refuse to pay are ordered to sign a contract with the government and corporates to become a frontier pioneer in the wastelands. While they are given full freedom without restrictions, it comes at the cost of their own safety such as criminals and constant natural disasters, and those corporations and government agencies will treat them as mere disposable pawns without providing basic welfare to them.

To some, the frontier pioneers in the wastelands symbolize the foundation of Columbia through bitter trials; many films and literary works romanticize the pioneers' struggle to conquer danger and their brave heroism. But to others, especially those of the intellectual circle, the pioneers represent Columbia's exploitation over the masses through financial inequality, a lack of education, and even political oppression against its dissidents.

entries.name: ---Blacksteel Worldwide---
entries.content:
Blacksteel Worldwide (BSW), or Blacksteel (BS) for short, is a Terran organization. It is a Columbian PMC armed with modernized weaponry that has been active across Terra while serving the national interest of the Columbian government. 


Background

Foundation
Blacksteel was founded in 1026 by the legendary veteran Rupert, better known by his nom de guerre "Clip" Cliff, after the Columbian War for Independence, hoping to continue his own military legacy in this newly born nation. Cliff knew exactly the kind of military force that Columbia would need, and he personally traveled to different cities looking for veterans of the Revolutionary War who were willing to return to the battlefield.

Barron Mine Incident
The Barron Mine Incident of 1083 serves as the rise of Blacksteel in the mercenary industry. Four years earlier, Tower Mountains began their experiments in the Barron Mine, an abandoned Originium mine located in southern Columbia, with the objective of developing ways for the Department of Defense to lead with Oripathy infections in combat environments. They began experimenting on living organisms, including Needlefly specimens, by injecting them active Originium inside their bodies in various ways. Their objective was to study the mutations that these creatures were undergoing, vowing to create intelligent-enough creatures that could fulfill certain purposes in the Army. However, the specimens eventually breached the laboratory's security systems, killing many of the scientists in the process. BS was hired to contain the incident, focusing on rescuing the scientific personnel with the aid of Janet Longfellow, a temporary civilian consultant at the time. After twenty three days of arduous efforts, all trapped personnel was rescued, and Blacksteel was awarded with the Citizen Medal of Honor by Maylander. The incident's details, however, were eventually leaked to public by the D.C. Telegraph, causing the then Secretary of Defense, Mr. Conbot, to resign his position.

Present days
For a long time since its establishment, BS served as governmental mercenaries who answered their call to the Federal Government of Columbia and other corporations. Since the Barron Mine Incident, and inspired by the ever-changing national mercenary industry, BS gradually reformed itself from a state-owned enterprise to a private company, registering their trademark in 1086. At the same time, BS actively engages with other companies across Terra, which eventually earned its name. Nevertheless, despite its nominal separation and activities as a private company, BS has never fully severed its tie from the Federal Government. The Columbian government still uses BS as a tool to both serve its governmental interests in its homeland and a pawn for its expansionism. To this day, BS has been involved in numerous conflicts in Victoria and Bolívar as part of Columbia's ambition, as well as BS's mission to end brutal conflicts.

entries.name: Blacksteel: Organization
entries.content:
Organization

True to its name, BS is not just an ordinary mercenary company, but one that is fully armed with both modern weapons and modern thoughts. Many of its operators are armed with, surprisingly, expensive, cutting-edge firearms — a privilege only reserved to the Laterans — thanks to its Sankta founder who brought said technology to Columbia. Unlike other mercenaries, Blacksteel's Operators rarely take any unnecessary risks. They usually accept contracts as guns-for-hire for Columbian agencies and corporations, while subcontracting those they judge for having "unnecessary risks". High-risk contracts are often subcontracted by selected BS squads. If completed, Blacksteel will receive a share of the reward. Once these mercenaries encounter any setback, Blacksteel will come up with a "compensation plan" to absorb them to the team for an affordable price.

Blacksteel consists of three major departments: The Administrative Branch, the Department of Equipment and Applied Technologies, and the Biochemical Protection Response Staff


Fort Barron
Blacksteel's headquarters, Fort Barron, is their signature state-of-the-art landship similar to Rhodes Island's namesake that allows BS operators to be mobilized with ease. The landship is currently the largest landship on Terra surpassing the Rhodes Island landship. It provides mobile administration, logistics and supply center, and professional personnel training. The landship itself is made from salvaged mining platform parts from the Barron Mine, and an abandoned modified warship exported from Bolívar. After two years of renovation and industrial acquisition procedures, Fort Barron was put into service almost at the same time the company was officially trademarked.

Fort Barron serves as the core of the Administrative Branch, which is responsible of all of BS's affairs, including business/legal matters, internal affairs, and external docking. Similar to other BS personnel, employees of the branch, generally refereed as "Accountants" regardless of their scope of abilities, also receive the most basic field training, but they don't require to pass through the same arduous training and assessment process than other mercenaries. The Recruitment center, also located in Fort Barron, provides professional personnel that meets the necessities of BS's business departments. It is mainly focused to trainees with no combat or military experience, and after at most two years of training, they can be assessed. The assessment results on the other hand determine whether they can become formal Operators, with about 76% of the recruits being eliminated.

Besides Fort Barron's training ground, which is mostly used to practice the operation techniques of their replica firearms, Blacksteel also controls various abandoned mobile plots and settlements in the wasteland, retrofitted for field combat training. Sometimes, these plots will be occupied by wandering wastelanders, so expelling them by force becomes part of the training. One example of BS-owned plates is Davistown

Department of Equipment and Applied Technologies
The Department of Equipment and Applied Technologies (DEAT) is the largest of all of BS's branches, which composes its main military force, responsible of providing traditional paramilitary services. This department is formed by all BS mercenaries who just enrolled from the Recruitment center, as well as equipment technicians and testers in charge of R+D. They answer to any kind of governments or legal entities and will fully serve their interest through wide range of services from escort, security guards, to disaster rescue, some of which requiring them to whitewash heinous crimes.

Initially, the Department of Equipment and Applied Technologies only provided services to Blacksteel mercenaries, mainly firearm maintenance. However, its business scope expanded and quickly became a business platform for many Columbian manufacturers such as Raythean Industries.
BPRS
The uniform of a BPRS specialist. The protective gear is made of highly reflexive synthetic fiber with a coat of Originium preventive solution.

The Biochemical Protection Response Staff, or BPRS for short, is a specialized unit led by Dr. Longfellow who are experienced handlers in hazardous incidents such as Oripathy pandemic. They are tasked to guarantee the safety of all Bio Department operations, as well as dealing with Oripathy cases within the company. The unit was originally designated to provide specialized formation to contain and prevent Oripathy infections, but over time, it evolved into a more independent unit with comprehensive technical and human support.


Infected policies
Blacksteel imposes five rules upon its Infected staff:
    1.Infected are forbidden from teaming up with non-Infected for any combat operation or high risk mission.
    2.Infected with light cases are allowed to team up with the non-Infected, but they must first request permission from the latter.
    3.Infected with mild cases are forbidden from joining any team operations, but are allowed to accomplish solo missions.
    4.Infected with severe cases will see their contract terminated immediately but will receive a decent amount of severance pay.
    5.All Infected who are still able to work will be given medical treatment by Blacksteel.

However, some regard this policy as a yet another example of exploitative treatment of the Infected, seeking to extract as much work as possible from the Infected before they are no longer of any use. Realistically, the monetary compensation from contract termination could never hope to fully pay for the medical bills of someone suffering from terminal Oripathy. Meanwhile, there are increasing tensions between the Infected and non-Infected members in the company.

Following the Ironforge "leakage" incident in 1095, BS has been actively collaborating in a special partnership with Rhodes Island, which provides treatment for Franka's Oripathy in exchange of security and escort services. On the other hand, they were ordered by the Columbian government to close an eye on it as it was actually with a secret weapon program that went haywire.


Firearms
A BSW handgun, modeled after the real-world Beretta 92

An integral part of Blacksteel's identity and theory core is the use of pneumatic, reverse-engineered firearms and ammunition, a technology that Cliff himself brought using Laterano's firearms as a basis. These weapons are commonly limited to small, easy-to-use handguns and hunting rifles, and can provide supporting firepower or tactical supplements. All BS personnel are trained on a certain capacity on the use of firearms, giving them considerable firepower advantage on short/medium range combat.

Compared to Lateran fireams, Blacksteel's firearms have reduced performance due to their mechanically-simplified internal components and streamlined etched ammunition structure, as well s its distincitve operation method. These specialized weapons, while optimized, require a precise use of Originium Arts from the user to activate the etched crystals within the bullets, and its performance on actual combat environments highly demands on the user's quality and experience. An inapropiate use of the user's Arts could result in the gun jamming —or in the worse case scenario, a squib load due to the excessive casting of the bullet inside the chamber, causing the etched crystals to ignite and explode, resulting in the user contracting Oripathy. On the other hand, acquiring and maintaining a BS firearm is often quite expensive.

Nevertheless, BS has been actively improving its replica firearm templates in order to facilitate its use for non-Sankta users, and as such, the personnel's training and equipment costs have increased. According to statistics from the Fort Barron Training Center, under the current firearm technology and training conditions, the time and resources needed to train a non-Sankta marksman or shooter is enough to equally train three skilled crossbowmen.

entries.name: ---Rhine Lab---
entries.content:
Rhine Lab LLC. (R.L.) is a Terran organization. They are a Columbian research institute and scientific consortium that is active in the fields of Originium, biology, and robotics, but have been marred with shady practices involving unethical, inhumane experiments. Nevertheless, they have a grand ambition to become Terra's pioneer in space expedition. 

Foundation
Rhine Lab was founded by Dr. Kristen Wright and Saria, two equally-minded graduates from the Trimounts Institute of Technology, in the year 1083 with the purpose of seeking scientific advancements and following the legacy of the former's parents in exploring space beyond Terra. R.L. came from humble beginnings with its first office being an old apartment near the founders' former college. A year later, Muelsyse, a young Elf girl, joined the duo. Despite this, R.L. was struggling with management affairs. They heavily relied on investors and other third-parties' funds, and their projects were limited to high-energy physics and life research. That would change in 1085, when the trio decided to consult Jara Wilson, a former Wrankwood star who became one of Columbia's top investors. She provided enough investment to upgrade R.L. into a formal LLC. The same year, Ahrens Parvis and Ferdinand Clooney joined the company as well.

R.L. eventually became one of Terra's biggest scientific organizations, famous throughout Terra for their Originium-related research and uses in robotics, medicine, and ecological studies. Through collaboration with the Maylander Association, it began attracting more researchers to join the company. In 1090, Rhine Lab's "Section System" was established; Kristen Wright became the Director of the Component Controls section and head of R.L. as a whole, while Saria took up the position as chief of the Defense section. On the other hand, Jara became director of the Human Resource Investigation Section. Two years later, the Scientific Investigation and Engineering Sectiosn were established, with Andenate Maryam and Nasti Lunorey being appointed as their respective directors. At the same time, Justin Fitzroy Jr. became the head of the Business Section, and the construction of R.L.'s new headquarters officially wrapped up.

However, R.L. eventually became involved in ethically questionable research, which they have simply deemed "unavoidable." The company accepts funding from the Columbian Department of Defense (DOD) as part of the nation's goal to achieve technological superiority over other Terran superpowers. For example, in order to decode the secrets of Originium, Joyce was chosen to have an Originium chip implanted inside her brain, but this came at the cost of her contracting severe Oripathy, along with other illnesses. R.L. even secretly invested in the infamous Loken Watertank Laboratory, inheriting much of its legacy after its downfall by accepting its remaining research data and subjects. They continue to use the façade of appearing as an institution of academic freedom to attract researchers while disguising their true intentions. 


Organization

Section System
R.L. has ten departments in total, named Sections with each performing different tasks led by the Board of Directors, nicknamed "The Ten Rhine Talents". The core of R.L. is the Component Control Section (CMPT CTRL) that deals with the general affairs within R.L. among all departments. Beneath the Control Section are five scientific research sections and four general affair sections. Each of the scientific research sections have a different direction and approach, and the directors themselves have the rightful power to not only influence the workflow, but also deal with commercial commissions that are in line with their own research directions. Kristen rarely took part of the sections' small-scale projects. If a project affecting the entire company is found, or there's a commission that involves multiple sections, the board of directors can directly discuss the matter with Kristen. Only when she makes the final decision, the scientific research sections will apply the formulated profit distribution plan between the company and the Component Control Section. The general affairs sections on the other hand work akin to functional departments of a general company (i.e. human resource management, business affairs)

Scientific research:
    1.Ecological Section (ECO): The department that investigates the biological evolution history of Terra and its interaction with Terra's environment.
    2.Energy Section (NRG): The department that conducts research on various forms of energies in Terra (i.e., Originium, sunlight, geothermal, and biothermal) and their practical applications in technology.
    3.Originium Arts Section (ORIG): The department that dives into the basic principles of Originium Arts and its applications.
    4.Scientific Investigation Section (SCIEN): The department consists of explorers that reach outside of the borders of civilization on Terra (i.e., Sami Icefield) to investigate its mysteries and uncover relics of Terra's previous civilizations. The S.I.S. is the leader of R.L.'s Pioneer Project.
    5.Structural Section (STRU): The department that investigates the basic particles (i.e., elements, atoms, and biological molecules) of living beings on Terra and how they are affected by their surroundings. Despite initial criticism, Kristen managed to push forward the section's development and launched a series of initial field surveys.

General affair:
    1.Business Section (BSN): The department that deals with public affairs and communications with other corporations.
    2.Defense Section (DEF): The department that deals with R&D and security issues such as laboratory emergencies. It also takes care of undisclosed and classified information. Prior to the Diαbolical Crisis, it was considered the most powerful section, having the right to terminate projects and assess risks from a security perspective.
    3.Engineering Section (ENG): The department that provides mechanical and robotic support for R.L.'s researchers.
    4.Human Resource Investigation Section (HRI): The department that is responsible for human resource management.

Along with its scientific endeavors, the Maylander Association also helped R.L. start the Rhine Lab Pioneer Project: a series of archeological expedition programs to uncover ancient ruins, many of which actually belonged to the previous civilizations which once colonized Terra.

entries.name: -----Higashi-----
entries.content:
Higashi or historically called Ko-ashihara is a Terran country located northeast of Yan where it enjoys strong diplomatic relations, which has encouraged cultural exchange between the two states. While Higashi is made up of various races, it is predominated by the Oni as well as a handful of Aegir.

Higashi’s history could be traced back to the veneration of a goddess whose descendants became the Emperor of Higashi, or the "Toukou". Entering the medieval era, however, Higashi fractured into a diarchy of two ruling clans: the Kougon of the north and the Mitsumoto of the south, with both clans setting up their own respective emperors. Following a devastating civil war, both clans evolved into different forms of government with the North retaining the old bakufu and the South evolving to a modernized constitutional monarchy. While the nation prospers in the era of peace, a bubble economy is slowly building up due to over-investment that might fracture the fragile truce. 


History
Founding myth
Higashi's founding myth could be found in a legend recorded in Records of Tales from Past (『今昔聞言略事録』)[note 1] written around the year 300 that narrated the origin of Higashi's imperial dynasty. Long ago, the land of Higashi was a land of disaster because it was plagued by a mysterious “chaos” called the Magatsu (禍津), causing the sky to turn abnormally colorful yet without day and night. To the south of Higashi, there existed an eight-headed evil “god” named the Ara-no-kami (荒の神) who created endless droughts, forcing the people to seek shelter in a reed swamp. Seeing their people undergoing suffering, the sun god of Higashi, Hinomitsuru Kami-no-Mikoto, personally killed the Magatsu with his sacred sword which was shattered into the Five Pillar Gods (五柱佐津天神), and the Five Pillar Gods would soon assisted him in slaying the Ara-no-kami.

The battle against the Ara-no-kami was a tough one due to Its regenerating trait and Its blood that could burn, and the five gods sacrificed themselves in Its jaws. Nevertheless, the blood split further strengthened the mortals which created the five tribes of Higashi. Together, the tribes succeeded in cutting Its heart, only to uncover a nine-tailed Phidian goddess who would later be named Asayo-Yoruakeru no Hime-no-Mikoto. The awakening of Asayo-Yoruakeru not only brought day and night to Higashi for the first time, but also, she united the five tribes and declared the foundation of Ko-ashihara, the Land of Reed Swamp, at Goshin Shinka-kyo by crowning her son Jingi as the emperor of Higashi whose bloodline continues in present days.


Ritsuryō era
For the first few centuries, Ko-ashihara prospered under the guidance of the Asayo-Yoruakeru's lineage. The emperors managed to pacify the invading Aegir and Oni clans and turned them into their subjects regardless of their enmity in the past. By the time of Emperor Sangaku, Yanese culture and political structure was first introduced that ushered in the era of a strong, centralized bureaucracy, and Ko-ashihara was renamed "Higashi" under Yanese influence.

However, the constant Catastrophes that devastated the commonfolk's lands, religious tensions between temples and Shinto shrines, and the imbalance among the royal house and the feudal daimyos slowly destabilized the nation. Many daimyos quietly gathered up their armies in preparation for a potential war. In the midst of the chaos, a rising samurai clan led by its shogun, Oniayame Shigekazu, ousted the royals' power and established the bakufu system around Terran year 400. His sixty years of rule was marked by an iron fist who allowed the samurai to take control over Higashi in the name of restoration of order.

Unfortunately, following Shogun Shigekazu's passing, the samurai clans violated the fragile balance with the royals by establishing the northern Kougon clan, formerly a close ally with the royals, as the head of state of Higashi. Series of political struggles led to the fall of the Oniayame clan. On the other hand, the southern Mitsumoto clan were disgraced by the Kougon's action and sought to preserve the genuine emperor, and to others' surprise, the fallen Oniayame clan, now led by Shigekazu's eldest son Seisaku, chose to side with the Mitsumoto. The clash eventually led to the founding of the Northern and Southern Courts and a total civil war across Higashi.


Warring era
For the next three century, the Higashi North-South War or the Kokusen-shouran (国戦戕乱) devastated the once-peaceful country. The war even shocked the Yanese imperial court, and the True Lung urged both sides to calm down while condemning the Oniayame's disloyalty to the Kougon. It was marked with numerous humanitarian crises such as sabotages and assassinations like the Kujin-gari (九人狩り), the "Bloody Hunt of Nine." As the war prolonged, the Kougon, armed with superior weapons, proved to be the winner of the war, yet the Mitsumoto had the resources and the leading royal house that could exhaust the Kougon's army. By the year 635, Shogun Seisaku passed away due to Oripathy during a campaign, and the Oniayame clan completely vanished into history after the Mitsumoto no longer trusted them due to such an ungraceful end. The war also gave rise to the Eight Families, and each half of them started to gain political control over the Courts to lessen the bloodshed. In the year 801 as both sides grew weary over the conflict, a truce was signed in the nominal capital of Goshin Shinka-kyo, and the North-South rule was finally solidified.

Conflicts between both sides continued to a smaller degree. Loyalties between members of both courts were notoriously fickle, and defections to either side were a common sight. But it was the Bloodpeak Campaign in the year 1072, a total invasion of the Ursus Empire onto Higashi, forcing the Kougon and Mitsumoto to form an uneasy alliance. The retaliation was successful in which Higashi managed to invade Ursine soil, and the devastation resulted in the decline of the Ursus Empire following the Great Rebellion. However, it was a pyrrhic victory because the Ursi's superior military strategies and weapon industries easily crushed the Kougon's samurai, forcing the North to seek aid from the industrial South. After the war ended, Yan acted as mediator between the two powers in regards to compensation and POW exchange, eventually easing the tension.


Present days
For the next twenty years after the Bloodpeak Campaign, both sides chose to focus economic activities and rebuilding of the country, ushering in a short period of peace called the “Recovering Twenty Years.” The North has turned into a military base, while the South becomes a mercantile land that focuses more on commercial economy and trading. Because the South is the least devastated area, it is able to export many electronic devices to other nations along with its rising subcultures admired by the youth even until present days. In the year 1080, the Mitsumoto even took a drastic step by reforming its political structure to a cabinet system under the advice from overseas students in Yan and Leithanien. While the North is still under the traditional bakufu system led by stubborn conservatives, it slowly embraced modernization via investments from Yan. The old military industries evolved to heavy industries through the help of the four families. Once rejecting modern culture, even the North slowly accepts the rising subculture of the South which they see as a method to unite both courts. Nevertheless, the current economic prosperity is built upon the frail trust between the two factions which could collapse under potential circumstances in the future.

Higashi also appears to have been facing otherworldly threats as well. Due to its proximity to the sea where the nation's Aegir populace comes from, the coastal regions have been an active ground for the Church of the Deep where they operate underground. Its proximity to the Infy Icefield where the northern demons, aka. the Collapsals, lurking around, also force Higashi to station military bases in the snowy tundra.

entries.name: Higashi: Administration and politics
entries.content:
Administration and politics

Ritsusei system
In the past, Higashi has an Emperor titled the “Toukou” (東皇) whose claims their lineage being traced back to the goddess Asayo-Yoruakeru no Hime-no-Mikoto. Under the influence of Yanese legalism, Higashi adapted a system called the Ritsuseikoku system (律政国制) since the era of Emperor Sangaku by copying Yanese laws, creating a central government similar with the Yanese imperial court, and setting up a kuge class guided by the kugyō (公卿).
